grouping.point: One test session a tester runs end to end on one page, under one setup.
grouping.step: One thing to do and check inside a point. ids lists every original check the step covers; repeat_for lists the variants of a merged step.
grouping.coverage: Every one of the 9947 original checks appears in exactly one step.

priority.P0: Blocks launch: money, data loss, security, privacy, store rejection, or a core flow that cannot be finished.
priority.P1: Core flow or common case. Must pass before public production; a known workaround may be accepted in writing.
priority.P2: Polish, rare edge case, or cosmetic. Log it; it does not block launch.

type.functional: Does the feature do what it says on the happy path.
type.offline: Behaviour with no internet, while queued, and on reconnect.
type.degraded: A dependency is missing or partly broken: printer, KDS, LAN peer, vendor, flag, old version.
type.permission: Who may and may not see or do this (role, branch, blocked page).
type.validation: Bad, missing, or out-of-range input is refused with a clear message.
type.money: Totals, rounding, IQD, cash boxes, refunds, deposits: every dinar accounted for.
type.data: Data is saved, shown, and kept correctly; nothing is lost or duplicated.
type.realtime: Changes made elsewhere show up live without a reload.
type.i18n: Arabic and English text, right-to-left layout, digits and dates.
type.a11y: Screen readers, labels, contrast, tap/click target size, keyboard.
type.security: Secrets, tokens, injection, data exposure, headers.

findings.issue: The minimum play age is still a placeholder in both legal catalogues (legal.en.ts:40 [FILL: age], legal.ar.ts:32). LEGAL_STRICT=1 pnpm check:legal fails, and the stores will reject a privacy/terms page with a placeholder.
findings.resolution: Minimum play age set to 4 (EN+AR); strict legal check passes.

findings.issue: The production EAS profile has EXPO_PUBLIC_ONLINE_PAYMENTS and EXPO_PUBLIC_TOURNAMENTS on (since 74f36dec, 2026-10-25), while Qi payments are paused on the server and the comment in enabled.ts says payments must be off for the store build. Decide the launch value of each flag.
findings.resolution: Online payments off in every EAS profile, guarded by a test; every online-pay entry point unreachable. Tournaments follow the branch setting (build flag removed).

findings.issue: The store listing says there is no online payment, but the review notes describe Qi Card tickets and open matches, and the store docs say version 1.0.0 while app.config.ts says 1.1.0. Build, listing and notes must agree before submission.
findings.resolution: Store listing, review notes and Play data safety rewritten for 1.1.0: no online payment, open matches on (seats paid at the club); terms and privacy updated (terms version 2026-11-01).

findings.issue: Confirmed live on 2026-10-30: www.touch-padel.com/.well-known/apple-app-site-association serves appID TEAMID-UNSET.com.kagu.touchpadel and assetlinks.json has an empty sha256_cert_fingerprints, because APPLE_TEAM_ID and ANDROID_SHA256_FINGERPRINTS are not set in Vercel. /auth, /m and /c links open the browser instead of the app.
findings.resolution: Set APPLE_TEAM_ID and ANDROID_SHA256_FINGERPRINTS in Vercel after the apps are live in the stores (owner decision).

findings.issue: The offline PIN check exposed by the shell (touch.unlockPin) is never called by the screens. Offline, PIN-gated refunds, voids, discounts and overrides are queued with whatever PIN is typed and only fail after reconnect with PIN_INVALID. The drill runbook's 'accepted via offline PIN cache' claim is not what the code does.
findings.resolution: Offline PIN-gated actions and idle-lock unlock verify against the station's local PIN cache; a wrong PIN is refused on the spot.

findings.issue: An offline tab's total and change leave out tax and promotions, and the queued settle carries no amount; the server charges its own full amount at replay. Cash taken offline can be short and the gap only shows at Day close.
findings.resolution: All tax rates set to 0 (0380); the offline estimate uses the server's maths; a queued settle carries the expected total and a changed total is refused, not charged.

findings.issue: Idle-lock unlock calls verify_own_pin online with no offline path, so a till that idle-locks during an outage cannot be unlocked until the connection returns.
findings.resolution: Offline PIN-gated actions and idle-lock unlock verify against the station's local PIN cache; a wrong PIN is refused on the spot.

findings.issue: start_break, end_break and cover_station are online-only, so a person on break when the internet drops cannot end the break on that station.
findings.resolution: Breaks removed from the operator and the phone (schema kept, no calls).

findings.issue: In OfflineTabPanel, Card settles an offline tab in one tap with no confirmation, no amount and no shift gate, and the panel offers no discount (drill step 8 cannot be performed).
findings.resolution: Offline payments go through a confirm step with the amount and the shift check; discount always available; a settle refused on replay can be retried or set aside.

findings.issue: /till has no station-kind guard: on a KDS-mode station a cashier can take Cash or Card with no shift gate.
findings.resolution: Owner decision: no change needed.

findings.issue: Only a till-mode station runs the LAN kitchen server, so orders queued offline on a desk or shop station never reach the KDS. On LAN fallback the till's buffer replays every order of the session, so tickets already completed on the cloud board can come back as new; a bump with the LAN link down sends nothing and shows no error.
findings.resolution: Orders not seen by any kitchen screen within 20 s are flagged 'not received by the kitchen' on the till and desk; LAN-down bumps show an error; LAN fallback no longer replays completed tickets.

findings.issue: Paying wages, advances or coach statements from the safe never checks the balance, so the safe can go negative silently; coach Mark paid does not refresh the Safe page.
findings.resolution: Paying wages, advances or coach statements from the safe beyond its balance is refused: 'Not enough money in the safe' (0387, server-enforced).

findings.issue: Retrying after a lost answer records the first values: the advance dialog replays the first amount even when it was changed, and Mark paid records the first 'paid from' source while the toast names the new one.
findings.resolution: Advance and Mark paid are disabled offline with a reason; the request key follows the amount and source so a retry never records old values.

findings.issue: The courts export's 'Hours booked' and 'Available hours' columns hold minutes (60x error); percentages export as whole numbers without %; drill-through totals are wrong past 500 rows; after-midnight sales group under the calendar date instead of the business day.
findings.resolution: Exports: hours in hours, % with sign, totals from the server past 500 rows, business-day grouping (0388).

findings.issue: No crash reporter is wired in any app: setReporter is never called (apps/mobile/src/lib/telemetry.ts:39) and no Sentry SDK is installed, so production crashes and the Apple-revoke failure on account deletion go unseen.
findings.resolution: Dev-role Monitoring panel; every app, edge function, scheduled job and setup check reports there; 'Report crash' buttons on every crash screen. Email to contact@kagusoftware.com is a stub until a provider is chosen; no uptime pager yet.

findings.issue: Pages the owner blocks in Staff Access (0345) are not enforced on the phone: blocked_areas is read but never used. On the server, 0345 says no RPC reads staff.blocked_areas either, so a blocked person can still call those RPCs directly: the block is screens-only on every surface, not a hard wall.
findings.resolution: Blocked areas enforced on the server for every RPC (0384 pre-request hook) and on every phone staff screen.

findings.issue: The owner assistant queries ['assistant'] are not excluded from the AsyncStorage persister, so owner figures sit in the phone's plain cache until sign-out.
findings.resolution: Owner decision: no change needed.

findings.issue: requireStaffRole in the edge functions reads only the main staff.role, not 0345 second jobs, so a cashier with court_desk as a second job gets 403 from desk-customer-create; receipt-scan ignores second jobs too.
findings.resolution: Second jobs give full access of both roles in RPCs, phone lists and edge functions (0383).

findings.issue: There is no PITR and no staging project (org on Free). Confirm a restorable backup exists before go-live.
findings.resolution: Message to the backend department prepared (backups, PITR, staging, restore rehearsal).

findings.issue: 13 electron waivers plus node-forge and zod expire 2026-11-16 (UTC); every push goes red that day unless Electron is upgraded or the waivers are extended with Majed's word. The braces waiver (2026-11-04) and one vite waiver are now stale and can be deleted. The gate passes today (18 waived, 0 blocking).
findings.resolution: Message to the security department prepared. Note: 5 new node-forge advisories make the audit gate red today.

findings.issue: Court bookings have no PRICE_CHANGED path: Review shows the hold price and Success shows the price confirm_booking returns, so a moved price is only seen after confirming (app/review.tsx:182). Matches and lessons handle it.
findings.resolution: Court booking warns before confirming when the price changed; a PRICE_CHANGED refusal shows the new price.

findings.issue: The nightly db bench has been red every night 2026-10-19 to 2026-10-30, with 7 regressions in the latest run (replay.drain_500 +87%, booking.contention@50 +67%) besides Docker Hub rate limits. DB drift failed 2026-10-29 (undeployed migration on main while CI was red) and is green again since.
findings.resolution: Majed fixes CI; causes identified (hold-strike settle per hold, branch-guard trigger, double realtime sends, plpgsql analytics helpers) with fixes suggested.

findings.issue: Offline, the top strip says changes are saved here and will sync once the connection is back, but admin saves are never queued: they fail with 'No connection' and the change is lost. The banner over-promises for every online-only page.
findings.resolution: Allowlisted admin saves made offline are queued durably and replay exactly once (rpc.queued, 0395); the offline banner tells the truth.

findings.issue: Operator releases are unsigned on Windows: no WIN_ESIGNER_*, WIN_CSC_LINK or AZURE_* secrets exist although eSigner was chosen 2026-10-17 (Mac signing secrets exist). Stations show SmartScreen warnings.
findings.resolution: Windows signing later (owner).

findings.issue: docs/security/eas-update-signing.md records the EAS Update private key as not done. If the key is lost the app rejects every OTA update.
findings.resolution: EAS Update signing key: another department.

findings.issue: No uptime monitor and no paging exist anywhere; an outage is only noticed by people at the club.
findings.resolution: Dev-role Monitoring panel; every app, edge function, scheduled job and setup check reports there; 'Report crash' buttons on every crash screen. Email to contact@kagusoftware.com is a stub until a provider is chosen; no uptime pager yet.

findings.issue: The legacy building-wide realtime topics kds and floor are still sent on by 0238 and 0352, and any branch's kitchen and till staff may subscribe, so with two branches open one branch hears the other's tickets and waiter calls. Drop them before a second branch opens.
findings.resolution: No building-wide realtime topics; branch guards on split/promotion reads; managers see only their branches' staff requests and staff; Telegram, sync and merge records owner-only (0382, 0400).

findings.issue: split_evenly (0015) and split_by_item (0053) check only is_staff(cashier, manager, owner) with no VENUE_MISMATCH guard, so a cashier at one branch can likely read another branch's bill totals and lines.
findings.resolution: No building-wide realtime topics; branch guards on split/promotion reads; managers see only their branches' staff requests and staff; Telegram, sync and merge records owner-only (0382, 0400).

findings.issue: Neither /kds nor /shop checks the station kind, so a manager can sell at /shop from the café till and that cash lands in the café till's open shift.
findings.resolution: /shop opens only on a shop station and /kds only on a kitchen screen or the café till.

findings.issue: When the receipt printer is missing or fails, the app silently opens the system print dialog with no message and no log. No kitchen tickets are printed anywhere (the 'kitchen' print kind exists only in the IPC validator). The desk court fee panel has no receipt print.
findings.resolution: Every print has 'Print again'; a failed print shows a message and reports to monitoring; the desk court bill prints.

findings.issue: Online-only actions pressed offline show 'Something went wrong' (UNKNOWN code) instead of 'No connection'; the pairing card shows a generic error instead of 'Incorrect PIN' for an uncached PIN offline.
findings.resolution: Online-only actions offline say 'No connection'; the pairing card says 'Incorrect PIN'.

findings.issue: No warning about unsent basket lines on Cash/Card (unsentWarning copy unused); offline Send to kitchen waits about 8 s then empties the basket with no 'queued' notice; split-bill cash has no change figure; 'Charge to booking' shows on a settled tab with no booking; Card has no disabled reason while Cash does.
findings.resolution: Paying with unsent lines needs a warning and confirm; offline send-to-kitchen shows a queued state; split cash shows change.

findings.issue: Open drawer is online-only and there is no drawer kick, so no-sale openings during an outage leave no record.
findings.resolution: Owner decision: no change needed.

findings.issue: The KDS has no bar-only or kitchen-only filter; every bar and kitchen role sees the full ticket list.
findings.resolution: Owner decision: no change needed.

findings.issue: Arabic-Indic digits are refused in the rewards target, stock count entry (blocks Finish), recipe amounts, ingredient numbers and shop product price, cost and low level.
findings.resolution: Number boxes that take only 0-9 say 'Use English digits (0-9)'.

findings.issue: Driver purchases and scanned receipts with a shop product are refused (INVALID_ARGUMENT); Finish on /shop/counts sends shop_staff to /stock/variance, which they cannot open; a new product is left without a size if the second save call fails, and saving again duplicates it.
findings.resolution: Shop products can never be deleted; a new product from a purchase is approved into the list; product and size saved in one call (0389).

findings.issue: Analytics silently falls back to 30 days for ranges over 400 days and Reports shows the wrong error; analytics export times use the PC clock, not Baghdad; /plan flags today's idea as past between 00:00 and 04:00.
findings.resolution: Business day starts at 04:00 everywhere; exports use Baghdad time; ranges over 400 days are refused with a message.

findings.issue: Marketing share bars are rescaled to 100 and disagree with the server; overlapping interests are scaled to 100% so each reads too low; some shares show decimals against the whole-percent rule.
findings.resolution: Insights shares are shown exactly as the server sends them; a test proves agreement.

findings.issue: Shared-list pushes count second jobs but phones show lists by main role only, so a person can be pushed for a list they cannot see. The operator hard-codes Asia/Baghdad while the server uses venues.timezone. Stations on an operator build before 0323 misread people lists.
findings.resolution: Checklists for a second-job role show on the phone; pushes and lists use the same audience (0383).

findings.issue: The cashier holds takeTournamentPayment but no screen takes an entry fee; several refunds (match call-off, over-paid bill, tournament refunds, paid no-show seat) are hand-offs with no button.
findings.resolution: Desk tournaments: Confirm participant (only then entered) and a Pay tab; confirmed but unpaid allowed (0390).

findings.issue: Free AI chats share one localStorage key per computer, so a second person on the same station overwrites the first's chats; the monthly-cap message points at Venue settings instead of /assistant/usage.

findings.issue: The table token is serialised into the menu's RSC payload and the 12-hour tp-table cookie is never cleared, so a walk-in who opens the menu within 12 hours is bound to their old table again.
findings.resolution: Table cookie lasts 2 hours and the token never reaches the browser.

findings.issue: There is no app/global-error.tsx, so an error in the root layout shows Next's default English page; an empty menu shows the same screen as a failed load; Retry does nothing if the Supabase env vars are missing.

findings.resolution: Message to the applications department prepared (Android submit profile, Firebase file, staging, app links, review account, data safety).

findings.resolution: Owner-only idle-lock timeout setting (server-enforced) and a Quit button on the lock screen.

findings.issue: A retired station keeps running and trading with no warning on the machine itself; it only stops pinning its branch.
findings.resolution: A retired station is locked out on screen and refused by the server, queued writes included (0398).

findings.issue: The Quit / Exit-full-screen PIN field enables at 4 digits while staff PINs are 6 to 12 digits.

findings.issue: Adding a closed day that already has bookings shows no warning in the editor.

findings.resolution: Owner decision: no change needed.

findings.resolution: Daily prune: cron history 7 days, replay tables 90 days (0386).

findings.issue: Buckets, storage policies and every cron schedule are created in blocks that only raise a NOTICE on failure, so they can be missing on hosted without any error. Verify each exists on hosted.
findings.resolution: Setup pieces are listed and checked; a missing one fails the deploy and the hourly check reports it to monitoring (0385).

findings.issue: An offline shop sale silently drops the member (no points earned; only a code comment says so), and shop sales recorded offline or settled slowly print no receipt.
findings.resolution: Offline shop sales keep the member's points and print an 'Offline receipt'.

findings.issue: A ticket marked Complete by mistake cannot be recalled (it fades and leaves the board after two minutes); the KDS 'Offline, tickets arriving' strip stays up after the till's LAN link drops; the till still says 'Order sent.' with no warning when the KDS is closed; bumps refused by a till with nobody signed in show nothing on the KDS.

The panel's average order value is shown as IQD only when whole.

findings.resolution: Copy, names and comments corrected; declining a request needs no reason; workflow and SECURITY.md text fixed.

findings.resolution: Copy, names and comments corrected; declining a request needs no reason; workflow and SECURITY.md text fixed.

findings.resolution: Copy, names and comments corrected; declining a request needs no reason; workflow and SECURITY.md text fixed.

conditions.label: Normal operation
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Online, signed in with the right role, data present

conditions.label: Signed in with a role that may not use this
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Sign in as the named role (accounts from Staff) with no second job and nothing blocked

conditions.label: No internet
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Unplug ethernet or turn Wi-Fi off; wait for the strip to turn red (one 10 s heartbeat)

conditions.label: Arabic, right to left
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Options › العربية (or the sign-in screen language button)

conditions.label: Nothing recorded yet
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Use a fresh branch or a local stack with no seed for that table

conditions.label: Two branches
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Create a second branch (Settings › Branches › Open a new branch) and switch with the rail Branch select on an unregistered PC

conditions.label: Two people change the same thing
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Do the same action on two stations within a few seconds

conditions.label: Offline, then back online
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Queue writes offline, then reconnect and watch the queue drain

conditions.label: Midnight / business-day boundary (Asia/Baghdad)
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Run the action between 00:00 and the business-day start hour Asia/Baghdad, or with a window crossing midnight

conditions.label: Server unreachable while the LAN is up
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Local: supabase stop; hosted: block the API host in the hosts file

conditions.label: Large data volume
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Seed hundreds of rows (menu items, audit entries, suggestions)

conditions.label: Small station screen
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Resize the window to about 1024 x 700

conditions.label: Network drops on and off
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Toggle Wi-Fi off/on during the action, or use dev tools offline toggling

conditions.label: Slow network
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Dev tools throttling Slow 3G (browser build) or a weak Wi-Fi

conditions.label: A feature switched off
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Turn the setting off (lessons, tournaments, loyalty, ranks, Telegram, offline mode, idle lock 0) or the EXPO_PUBLIC_TOURNAMENTS build flag

conditions.label: No session
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Sign out, or launch a configured station with no remembered session

conditions.label: Dark / blue display mode
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Switch the operator theme to dark, then blue

conditions.label: Third-party service down
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Remove the Telegram bot from the group / block api.telegram.org; pause the payment provider

conditions.label: Release secrets missing
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Run the release workflow in a fork or with a secret removed

conditions.label: Station app closed or power cut mid-flow
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Force-quit the operator app / pull power mid-action, reopen

conditions.label: Staff session expired
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Leave signed in past token expiry or revoke the session

conditions.label: Light appearance
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Settings > Appearance > Light (or Automatic with the phone in light mode)

conditions.label: Screen reader on
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Turn on VoiceOver (iOS) or TalkBack (Android)

conditions.label: Back gesture or button
conditions.how_to_reproduce: iOS edge swipe-back and the back item; Android system back button and back gesture

conditions.label: Largest OS text size
conditions.how_to_reproduce: iOS Settings > Accessibility > Larger Text max; Android Font size and Display size max

conditions.label: Blue colour mode
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Options › Blue mode (sign-in screen: Blue mode button); Light mode to go back

conditions.label: Station build older than the server
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Run a previous operator release against the current server

conditions.label: Venue offline mode on the server
conditions.how_to_reproduce: With the day open, keep every café cashier silent longer than "Café cashiers silent before offline mode"

conditions.label: Owner blocked a page for this person (0345)
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Staff › Manage › Access: untick a page under "Pages they can open"

conditions.label: The same idempotency key or request id is sent twice
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Replay the identical POST body (same idempotency_key / request_id) a second time

conditions.label: AI vendor rate limit (429) or free AI per-minute / club limit
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Paid: fire many questions quickly or use a low-tier key until the vendor returns 429. Free: ask the free AI many questions inside one minute

conditions.label: iOS-specific behaviour
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Test on a physical iPhone (latest iOS and one older)

conditions.label: Business day just closed
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Close the day on End of day count

conditions.label: No business day open
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Close the day (or start on a fresh branch) so no day session is open

conditions.label: Android-specific behaviour
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Test on a physical Android phone (one mid/low-end, one Huawei without Play Services if possible)

conditions.label: Opened from a link or push while the app was killed
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Kill the app, then tap the link in WhatsApp/Notes or the push notification

conditions.label: Operator PC clock set to a time zone other than Asia/Baghdad
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Set the Windows/macOS time zone of the PC to UTC or Europe/Istanbul

conditions.label: Registered station (station branch wins on the server)
conditions.how_to_reproduce: Open reports as owner on a PC registered as a station of branch A while the rail shows branch B or "All branches"

pages.name: Station first-run setup
pages.purpose: Shown instead of sign-in on an Electron machine with no station.json: names the machine and picks what it is for (café cashier, desk, kitchen screen, Touch Shop desk); a kitchen screen pairs to a café cashier on the LAN with a code.

components.name: Mode choice
components.purpose: Picks till, desk, kds or shop and pre-fills a station name.

components.name: Station name field
components.purpose: Names the machine as it appears in the app and reports.

components.name: Kitchen screen pairing (code, LAN search, address)
components.purpose: Finds the café cashier on the LAN with the pairing code, or by a typed IPv4 address.

components.name: Finish setup / save station
components.purpose: Writes station.json through IPC and restarts.

steps.check: Choose Café cashier.
steps.expected: The details step opens with Station name pre-filled TILL-01 and no pairing fields.
steps.why: The default name must be valid so setup is one click for the common case.

steps.check: Go back and choose Desk, then Kitchen screen, then Touch Shop desk.
steps.expected: The station name pre-fills DESK-01, KDS-01 and SHOP-01 respectively; Back returns to the mode list each time.
steps.why: Wrong defaults lead to two machines sharing a name.

steps.check: Choose Kitchen screen.
steps.expected: The details step also shows "Pairing code from the café cashier" (hint explains Settings › Computers & screens › Kitchen screens on the café cashier) and a link "Enter the café cashier address yourself".
steps.why: A kitchen screen cannot receive tickets without pairing.

steps.check: Type "till 02" in Station name.
steps.expected: It normalises to TILL-02 as you type (uppercase, space becomes a dash).
steps.why: Inconsistent names split one machine's figures in reports.

steps.check: Type "till_3#!".
steps.expected: It becomes TILL-3 (underscore to dash, symbols dropped).
steps.why: Symbols in IDs break idempotency keys and reports.

steps.check: Clear the name, or type "-TILL" or "1TILL".
steps.expected: "Use capitals, digits and dashes, starting with a letter." shows and Finish setup stays disabled.
steps.why: A station id must start with a letter (STATION_ID_RE).

steps.check: Paste a 50-character name.
steps.expected: It is cut to 32 characters.
steps.why: Over-long ids overflow the rail and reports.

points.title: Kitchen screen pairing (code, LAN search, address): main flow
components: Kitchen screen pairing (code, LAN search, address)

steps.component: Kitchen screen pairing (code, LAN search, address)
steps.check: On a Kitchen screen setup, type a 9-character code and try Find the café cashier.
steps.expected: "The code is 10 letters and digits." shows and the search does not start.
steps.why: A wrong-length code would scan the LAN for nothing.

steps.component: Kitchen screen pairing (code, LAN search, address)
steps.check: Type the 10-character code shown on the till (Settings › Computers & screens › Kitchen screens › Show the code), with the till on the same network, and press Find the café cashier.
steps.expected: "Looking for the café cashier on this network…" shows, then with exactly one till answering the station saves ("Saving and restarting…") and restarts as a kitchen screen connected to that till.
steps.why: The kitchen board is how orders reach the bar and kitchen.

steps.component: Kitchen screen pairing (code, LAN search, address)
steps.check: Do the same with two tills on the network that both accept the code.
steps.expected: "More than one café cashier answered. Pick the one for this kitchen." with one button per till address; picking one saves.
steps.why: Pairing to the wrong till sends this kitchen another bar's tickets.

steps.component: Kitchen screen pairing (code, LAN search, address)
steps.check: Search with a wrong but well-formed code while the till is on.
steps.expected: "A café cashier answered but did not accept that code..." with "Type the code again", which clears the code field.
steps.why: A typo must not look like a network fault.

steps.component: Kitchen screen pairing (code, LAN search, address)
steps.check: Open "Enter the café cashier address yourself" and type 192.168.1.300.
steps.expected: "Enter a local network address like 192.168.1.10." and the step cannot continue.
steps.why: An invalid address is never saved.

steps.component: Kitchen screen pairing (code, LAN search, address)
steps.check: While "Looking for the café cashier…" is showing, press Back, then search again.
steps.expected: Back returns to the details with the code kept; the late result of the first search is ignored and does not jump the screen.
steps.why: A stale scan result must not save the wrong till.

points.title: Finish setup / save station: main flow

steps.check: On a Café cashier setup with a valid name press Finish setup.
steps.expected: "Saving and restarting…" then the app restarts to the sign-in screen; the rail later shows "Station TILL-01".
steps.why: The name is stamped on every queued write and heartbeat.

steps.check: Make the app data folder read-only and press Finish setup.
steps.expected: "The station could not be saved." with Try again and Back; Try again re-attempts the save.
steps.why: A silent failure loops the machine back to setup forever.

steps.check: After setup, sign in as owner, open Settings › Computers & screens › Cashier computers.
steps.expected: This machine is listed with a "Register this station" button until it is registered to a branch: first-run setup alone does not register it with the server.
steps.why: An unregistered till does not pin its branch and is not counted for day close.

steps.check: On the setup screen press the macOS red close button (or Quit to desktop at the top corner).
steps.expected: The "Quit to desktop" dialog opens ("This ends service on this station..."); confirming closes the app. On an unlocked machine no PIN is asked.
steps.why: A machine powered on by mistake must be closable before anyone signs in.

points.title: Station first-run setup: Café cashier (LAN peer) unreachable
components: Kitchen screen pairing (code, LAN search, address)

steps.component: Kitchen screen pairing (code, LAN search, address)
steps.check: Search with the till switched off.
steps.expected: Not found: "No café cashier answered on this network. Check the café cashier is switched on and on the same network, then search again — or enter its address." with Search again and Enter the café cashier address.
steps.why: A clear next step avoids a support call.

steps.component: Kitchen screen pairing (code, LAN search, address)
steps.check: Type a valid address of a till that is switched off and search.
steps.expected: "The café cashier at <host> did not answer. It may just be switched off: save anyway and this screen keeps trying until it answers." with a "Save anyway" button; saving restarts the station as a kitchen screen that connects once the till comes up.
steps.why: A kitchen screen installed before the till is powered must still be set up.

steps.component: Kitchen screen pairing (code, LAN search, address)
steps.check: With no address typed (search only) and the till off, check whether Save anyway is offered.
steps.expected: Save anyway is NOT offered for a plain "no café cashier answered" result; only an unreachable typed address can be saved anyway.
steps.why: Saving a kitchen screen with no till address leaves it paired to nothing.

points.title: Station first-run setup: ge
components: Kitchen screen pairing (code, LAN search, address)

steps.check: Install the operator on a clean machine (no station.json in the app data folder) and launch it.
steps.expected: The "Set up this station" screen shows before any sign-in, titled "What is this machine for?" with the lead "Pick one. This is done once on each machine." and four choices: Café cashier, Desk, Kitchen screen, Touch Shop desk, each with its one-line description.
steps.why: A new till that cannot be set up cannot trade.

steps.check: Open the operator in a browser (pnpm dev, not Electron).
steps.expected: No setup screen appears: the browser mock reports a configured station and the sign-in screen shows directly.
steps.why: Dev and e2e must not be blocked by an Electron-only step.

steps.check: Corrupt station.json (put invalid JSON in it) and launch the app.
steps.expected: A full-screen "The app could not start." card shows "station.json could not be read: <error>" instead of the sign-in screen; the machine does not trade as TILL1 by default.
steps.why: A broken install silently trading under a default name corrupts reports and offline counts.

steps.check: Switch the setup screen to Arabic if a language control is shown, otherwise set the stored locale to ar before first launch, and walk through setup.
steps.expected: All setup text is Arabic and mirrored; station names, the pairing code and IP addresses stay left-to-right.
steps.why: The person installing may only read Arabic.

steps.component: Kitchen screen pairing (code, LAN search, address)
steps.check: Search with the machine on no network at all (Wi-Fi off, cable out).
steps.expected: "This machine is not on a local network. Connect it to the venue network, then search again."
steps.why: Setup on a disconnected machine must say why it fails.

steps.check: Create station.json from another process between opening setup and pressing Finish setup.
steps.expected: "This station is already set up. Restart the app." and Try again does nothing more (only Back).
steps.why: Two writers must not overwrite a station's identity.

pages.name: Boot screen
pages.purpose: Covers start-up while the session and the staff row resolve; also the landing redirect wait.

steps.check: Launch the app with a remembered session.
steps.expected: The Touch Padel lockup and a spinner with "Signing you in and loading the venue’s settings…" show, then the person's home screen; the sign-in screen never flashes in between.
steps.why: A flashing sign-in on every boot makes staff think they were signed out.

steps.check: Launch with a remembered session and the network down.
steps.expected: The boot screen resolves (the session is local) and the shell opens with the red "Not connected" strip; the staff lookup failing as a network error does not show the "This account cannot use the staff app" screen.
steps.why: A Wi-Fi blip at boot must not lock a till out (SEC-35 unknown keeps the previous answer).

steps.check: Launch on a slow network.
steps.expected: The boot screen stays up (no blank page) until the staff row returns; there is no NotStaff screen flash before the home screen.
steps.why: A one-frame error flash on every slow boot erodes trust.

steps.check: Launch in Arabic.
steps.expected: The boot line is Arabic and centred.
steps.why: Arabic staff see this every morning.

pages.name: Staff sign-in
pages.purpose: Email and password sign-in for every staff role; also hosts the language, blue mode and Quit controls before anyone is signed in.

components.name: Sign-in form
components.purpose: Validates and submits credentials.

components.name: Quit to desktop (sign-in corner)
components.purpose: Lets a kiosk station be closed before sign-in.

steps.check: Press Sign in with both fields empty.
steps.expected: "Enter your email." shows under Email and focus moves there; no request is sent.
steps.why: Empty submits waste a round trip and confuse.

steps.check: Type an email, leave the password empty, press Enter.
steps.expected: "Enter your password." shows and the password field is focused.
steps.why: Clear field-level errors speed up a shift start.

steps.check: Enter a valid staff email with a wrong password.
steps.expected: The red line "That email and password do not match a staff account. Check both and try again." shows, the password field is cleared and focused, the email is kept.
steps.why: Wrong passwords must not leak which part was wrong.

steps.check: Turn Caps Lock on while typing the password.
steps.expected: "Caps Lock is on." shows as a hint under the password.
steps.why: Caps Lock is the most common sign-in failure at a till.

steps.check: Sign in with correct credentials of an active cashier.
steps.expected: The button shows busy, fields are read-only while waiting, then the Café cashier workspace (/till) opens.
steps.why: Staff must reach their workspace in one step.

steps.check: Press Sign in twice quickly.
steps.expected: Only one sign-in request is sent (the second press is ignored while busy).
steps.why: Double submits can trip auth rate limits.

steps.check: Sign in with leading/trailing spaces around the email.
steps.expected: Sign-in succeeds (the email is trimmed).

steps.check: On macOS Electron, drag the window by its top edge on the sign-in screen.
steps.expected: The window moves; the language and Quit controls under the top strip still click.
steps.why: An immovable window blocks the owner's desktop.

steps.check: Launch a configured station with no session.
steps.expected: Left: navy panel with the lockup and "More than a game"; right: "Staff sign-in", "Use your staff email and password.", Email (focused) and Password fields and a full-width "Sign in" button; bottom corner: Blue mode and العربية.
steps.why: Sign-in is the door to every till.

steps.check: Press العربية on the sign-in screen.
steps.expected: The whole screen switches to Arabic and mirrors (form on the left, language buttons in the bottom-left corner); the email and password fields stay left-to-right; the choice is remembered after restart.
steps.why: Arabic-first staff must be able to sign in.

steps.check: Press Blue mode on the sign-in screen, then Light mode.
steps.expected: Colours switch with no layout jump; the button is marked pressed in blue mode; the mode persists to the signed-in shell and across restarts.
steps.why: The station's chosen mode must hold from the first screen.

steps.check: Sign in with the station offline.
steps.expected: "The server could not be reached. Check this station’s network connection and try again." with a wifi-off icon; the password is kept.
steps.why: Staff must know it is the network, not their password.

steps.check: Sign in with an account the owner turned off (banned in auth).
steps.expected: "This account has been turned off. Ask the owner to turn it back on."
steps.why: A removed employee must get a clear refusal.

steps.check: On a kiosk station at the sign-in screen press "Quit to desktop" in the top corner.
steps.expected: The dialog explains "This ends service on this station. Orders stop and the venue sees it go offline." with Back and a red Quit to desktop; on a locked station it also asks for a "Manager PIN" ("A manager other than you has to enter their PIN.").
steps.why: A station nobody can close is a support call; a station anyone can close is lost service.

steps.check: In the browser build look for Quit to desktop.
steps.expected: It is not shown (no window.touch bridge).
steps.why: Browser mode has no kiosk to leave.

pages.name: Account cannot use the staff app
pages.purpose: Shown when the signed-in account has no active staff row, a retired/unknown role, or was deactivated while signed in.

points.title: Account cannot use the staff app: other parts

steps.check: Restore the person's access, then press Check again.
steps.expected: The app reloads and opens their home screen.
steps.why: Recovery must not need a restart of the station.

points.title: Account cannot use the staff app: ge

steps.check: Sign in with a guest (customer) account email and password.
steps.expected: "This account cannot use the staff app" with "You are signed in as <email>, but that account is not set up as active staff..." and two buttons: "Use a different account" (signs out) and "Check again" (reloads).
steps.why: Guests must never reach staff screens.

steps.check: Sign in as a coach (a guest account promoted in Coaches).
steps.expected: The same "This account cannot use the staff app" screen: coaches have no staff role and never sign in to the operator.
steps.why: Coaches must not see the till or the desk.

steps.check: While a cashier is signed in at a till, have the owner press Remove access for them on another machine; wait up to 60 seconds without touching the till.
steps.expected: Within about a minute (ROLE_RECHECK_MS) the till drops to this screen, live kitchen/floor/court updates stop arriving, and the queued-write worker no longer acts as them.
steps.why: A removed employee must not keep a live feed of orders for an hour (SEC-35).

steps.check: Repeat, but switch to another app and back to the operator right after access is removed.
steps.expected: Bringing the window to the front re-checks at once and shows this screen without waiting for the minute.
steps.why: The manager usually walks over to the till next.

steps.check: With a cashier signed in, drop the network for two minutes, then restore it.
steps.expected: The till stays on its screen the whole time (a failed lookup changes nothing) and never shows this screen.
steps.why: A Wi-Fi blip must not evict a cashier mid-sale.

steps.check: Give an account a role this build does not know (e.g. set a newer enum value in the DB on an old station build) and sign in.
steps.expected: This screen shows (an unknown role is treated as revoked), not an empty shell with no rail.
steps.why: An old station must refuse cleanly rather than show a navless app.

steps.check: View this screen in Arabic.
steps.expected: Title, body and buttons are Arabic; the email is shown left-to-right inside the sentence.
steps.why: Arabic staff must understand why they are refused.

pages.name: Landing redirect and role homes
pages.purpose: Sends a freshly signed-in person to their home route, or to the workspace picker the first time for a multi-workspace account.

points.title: Landing redirect and role homes: main checks

steps.check: On a station where no workspace was ever chosen (clear localStorage key touch-operator-workspace), sign in as a Cashier with no second job.
steps.expected: The app lands on /till with no workspace picker, because the account holds one workspace.
steps.why: Each role must land on the screen it works from, with nothing to choose.

steps.check: On a station where no workspace was ever chosen (clear localStorage key touch-operator-workspace), sign in as a Kitchen (retired prep) with no second job.
steps.expected: The app lands on /kds (the kitchen board, full screen, no rail) with no workspace picker, because the account holds one workspace.
steps.why: Each role must land on the screen it works from, with nothing to choose.

steps.check: On a station where no workspace was ever chosen (clear localStorage key touch-operator-workspace), sign in as a Manager with no second job.
steps.expected: The workspace picker (/workspaces) opens first because the account holds several workspaces; after a tile is chosen, later sign-ins on this station go straight to that workspace's home (/ops for Management).
steps.why: Each role must land on the screen it works from, with nothing to choose.

steps.check: Sign in as a Manager on a station where the last choice saved was Touch Shop.
steps.expected: The app opens the Touch Shop workspace (the station remembers the last workspace chosen, validated against the role).
steps.why: A manager who left the shop desk on the shop PC returns there.

points.title: Landing redirect and role homes: Who can and cannot use it

steps.check: As the owner, block nothing but give a Cashier a second job Court desk (Staff › Manage › Access) and sign in as that cashier on a fresh station.
steps.expected: The workspace picker opens with two tiles (Café cashier, Court desk); after choosing, Options › Switch workspace is available.
steps.why: A person covering two jobs must reach both without a second account (0345).

steps.check: As the owner, untick the Café cashier page for a Cashier who also has the Court desk second job, then sign in as them.
steps.expected: They land on /desk/today (the first of their jobs' homes they may open), not on a refusal card.
steps.why: A blocked main page must not strand the person on an error.

steps.check: Untick every page a Driver can open (My tasks) and sign in as them.
steps.expected: They land on /tasks where the guard says "The owner has closed this page for you. Ask them if you need it." with a Go to my home screen link.
steps.why: A fully blocked account must be told why it sees nothing.

steps.check: Sign in as a Cashier on a station whose remembered workspace is Management (left by a manager).
steps.expected: The cashier lands on the Café cashier workspace: a remembered workspace the role cannot hold is ignored.
steps.why: A shared station must never show one person's workspace to another.

pages.name: Choose a workspace
pages.purpose: Full-screen tile picker for anyone holding more than one workspace (manager, owner, or a second job); shows the station build.

steps.check: Sign in as the owner and open Options › Switch workspace.
steps.expected: "Choose a workspace" / "Pick the job you are doing now." with five tiles: Management, Court desk, Café cashier, Kitchen, Touch Shop, each with a line drawing, number 1–5 and its one-line lead; the current one is green and says "You are here".
steps.why: The owner moves between jobs many times a day.

steps.check: Press the digit 2 on the keyboard on the picker.
steps.expected: The second tile opens straight away with no confirmation question.
steps.why: Keyboard switching keeps a busy cashier fast.

steps.check: Open Go to (Ctrl+G) or another text field and type 3.
steps.expected: Typing in a field does not open a tile; Ctrl+3 is not treated as the digit either.
steps.why: Stray key presses must not throw someone into another workspace.

steps.check: Choose Management as a Manager.
steps.expected: Management opens on Today (/ops), not on the owner's Overview.
steps.why: A manager must never land on an owner-only refusal.

steps.check: Look at the foot of the picker.
steps.expected: "Version <x.y.z>" is centred; in Arabic the version number stays in Latin digits order and is not flipped.
steps.why: Support asks "which version is that till on" from this line.

points.title: Choose a workspace: Who can and cannot use it

steps.check: As a Cashier with a second job Court desk, open Options › Switch workspace.
steps.expected: The picker opens with exactly two tiles although the route is otherwise manager/owner-only (a second job opens /workspaces).
steps.why: A two-job person must be able to switch.

steps.check: Sign in as a Cashier account (role cashier, no second job, nothing blocked) and try to reach the workspace picker (/workspaces): look on the rail and in Options, then open the address directly (browser build URL bar, or a deep link from a push or the assistant on a station).
steps.expected: No rail row, family tab, section button or Go to entry leads to the workspace picker. Opened directly, the screen shows the card "Not allowed for your role: Opening this screen needs the Manager role. The control stays here so you can see what is available; ask someone with that role to do it." with a "Go to my home screen" link that lands on /till. No data from the page is fetched or shown.
steps.why: A role opening a screen outside its job exposes data or controls it must not have; the RPCs are the wall but the UI must not invite the attempt.

steps.check: Sign in as a Kitchen (retired prep) account (role prep, no second job, nothing blocked) and try to reach the workspace picker (/workspaces): look on the rail and in Options, then open the address directly (browser build URL bar, or a deep link from a push or the assistant on a station).
steps.expected: The kitchen board has no rail, so nothing on it leads there. Opened directly, the screen shows the card "Not allowed for your role: Opening this screen needs the Manager role. The control stays here so you can see what is available; ask someone with that role to do it." with a "Go to my home screen" link that lands on /kds. No data from the page is fetched or shown.
steps.why: A role opening a screen outside its job exposes data or controls it must not have; the RPCs are the wall but the UI must not invite the attempt.

steps.check: Make the window short (about 700 px tall).
steps.expected: Tile rows keep at least 14rem and the page scrolls; drawings are not squashed.
steps.why: Small screens must still show readable tiles.

steps.check: Open the picker in Arabic.
steps.expected: Tiles flow right-to-left, names and leads are Arabic, chevrons point the reading direction.

pages.name: Workspace shell (rail, sections, chrome)
pages.purpose: The signed-in frame: per-workspace rail or section rail, Go to, family tabs, branch switcher, Options menu, update row, identity and sign out, Quit and exit full screen, connectivity strip.

components.name: Go to palette (Ctrl+G)
components.purpose: Finds any page or settings tab the person may open in Management.

components.name: Family tabs under the page title
components.purpose: Shows a rail row's sibling pages as tabs under the page header.

components.name: Rail branch switcher / label
components.purpose: Shows which branch the screen is for; lets the owner (or a multi-branch person on an unregistered machine) switch.

components.name: Options menu (assistant, language, mode, switch workspace)
components.purpose: Station controls behind one rail row.

components.name: Connectivity strip (VenueStatusBanner)
components.purpose: One-line strip above every screen: connected, offline, upload blocked, or venue offline mode.

components.name: Update ready row / pill
components.purpose: Offers restart-to-install when the shell downloaded an update.

components.name: Identity block and Sign out
components.purpose: Shows who is signed in, their role, the station, and ends the session.

components.name: Quit to desktop and Exit forced full screen
components.purpose: Leaves the kiosk (reversible) or quits (ends service), PIN-gated on locked stations.

points.title: Workspace shell (rail, sections, chrome): main checks (1 of 2)

steps.check: Sign in as a Court desk account.
steps.expected: The rail (title "Court desk", lead "Bookings, arrivals and customers") lists: Today, Calendar, Customers, Coaches, New series, Block court, Tournaments, Open matches, Incident reports, My tasks; no Go to button; no section buttons.
steps.why: The desk rail is the desk's whole job.

steps.check: Sign in as a Cashier.
steps.expected: The rail lists: Café cashier, Open tabs, Customers, Cash drawer, Incident reports, My tasks.
steps.why: A cashier must find every till screen and nothing else.

steps.check: Sign in as a Barista (and repeat for Head barista, Assistant barista, Head chef, Chef assistant, Kitchen/prep).
steps.expected: No rail at all: the kitchen board fills the window on a dark background; a downloaded update shows as a floating pill instead of a rail row.
steps.why: A wall-mounted kitchen screen has nothing to get lost in.

steps.check: Sign in as Marketing.
steps.expected: Team workspace rail: Content plan, Sent for approval, My tasks, Insights.
steps.why: Marketing works only from its plan and posts.

steps.check: Sign in as a Driver, then as a Waiter.
steps.expected: Team rail shows only My tasks and Insights is absent (Insights is marketing and owner only); Content plan and Sent for approval are absent.
steps.why: Rows a role cannot open must not be printed.

steps.check: Sign in as a Shop assistant.
steps.expected: Touch Shop rail: Sell, Cash drawer, Shop stock, Goods in, Stock count, Products, Suppliers; nothing of the café.
steps.why: The shop assistant holds only the shop (0243).

steps.check: Sign in as the Owner and open Management.
steps.expected: Rail: Go to… (Ctrl+G) first, then Overview, Analytics, Assistant, Files, then section buttons Financial, Courts, Café & shop, Stock, Team, Customers & marketing, Settings, each with a forward chevron.
steps.why: The owner's map of the business must be complete.

steps.check: Sign in as a Manager and open Management.
steps.expected: Rail: Go to…, Today (instead of Overview), Files; Analytics and Assistant are absent; the same seven section buttons show, each opening the first page the manager may open (Financial opens Court sales, not Money in).
steps.why: A manager must never be sent to an owner-only refusal from the rail.

steps.check: Inside a section press the back control at the top of the rail.
steps.expected: The visible text is the workspace name ("Management") with a back chevron; screen readers hear "Back to Management"; it returns to the workspace home the person may open (Overview for owner, Today for manager).
steps.why: Leaving a section is the most-pressed rail control.

steps.check: Open a deep link to /admin/day-close (e.g. from a push) while in the Court desk workspace as a Manager.
steps.expected: The rail switches to Management's Financial section and the Cash row is lit; reloading the window keeps the same rail.
steps.why: The rail must match the screen after any link or reload.

steps.check: As Manager in Management › Courts, open Bookings (the desk calendar).
steps.expected: The Management Courts rail stays (it is not swapped for the Court desk rail).
steps.why: Losing the section rail strands the manager.

steps.check: As Manager open /kds from a link while in Management.
steps.expected: The kitchen board opens full-bleed in the Kitchen workspace with no rail; the board has its own way back.
steps.why: The manager checking the board must see what the kitchen sees.

points.title: Workspace shell (rail, sections, chrome): main checks (2 of 2)

steps.check: Look at rail badges with waiting items (e.g. one new staff suggestion, one incident open).
steps.expected: The row (and its section button, and a closed group) shows a green count; screen readers read "<n> waiting on you"; a zero count shows nothing.
steps.why: Counts are how management notices work waiting on them.

steps.check: Open Management with a very long staff name (40 characters).
steps.expected: The identity block wraps the name, the role badge stays visible, the station line ("Station TILL-01") stays on its own line; the sign-out icon keeps its full touch size.
steps.why: Rulebook: who is signed in and which till must always be legible.

steps.check: In Management press Ctrl+G (Cmd+G on macOS).
steps.expected: The "Go to" dialog opens with the search "Find a page or a setting" focused and a list "Pages and settings".
steps.why: Finding a setting must not need the page map.

steps.check: Type "deposit" and press Enter.
steps.expected: The top match (Courts › Court settings › Online deposit) opens and the dialog closes; Arrow keys move the highlight before Enter.
steps.why: Keyboard search is the fastest way to a setting.

steps.check: In the Court desk or Café cashier workspace press Ctrl+G.

steps.check: Open Opening hours with the network throttled to Slow 3G in dev tools (browser build) or on a weak venue Wi-Fi.
steps.expected: A loading state (spinner or skeleton) holds the layout until data arrives; no half-filled form is editable before its saved values land, and nothing flashes an empty-state message first.
steps.why: A form that becomes editable before its values load can save blanks over real settings.

steps.check: With the station online, stop the backend (local stack: supabase stop; hosted: block the API host in the hosts file) and open Opening hours.
steps.expected: The page shows "This could not be loaded." (or the network line) with a "Try again" button instead of a blank screen; pressing Try again after the backend is back loads the page without a restart.
steps.why: A blank admin page during an outage looks like lost data.

steps.check: Disconnect the station from the internet (unplug ethernet or turn Wi-Fi off), wait for the top strip to turn red, then open Opening hours.
steps.expected: The strip reads "Not connected — changes are saved here and will sync once the connection is back." The page shows its last loaded data if it was opened earlier this session, otherwise the error "This could not be loaded." with "Try again". Any save fails with "No connection. Check your internet and try again." and nothing is queued: after reconnecting, the change is NOT on the server and must be redone.
steps.why: Admin writes are online-only (appRpc); a manager who trusts the strip's "will sync" wording would lose the change.

steps.check: Save offline.
steps.expected: Network error; hours unchanged.

pages.name: Till (cafe cashier)
pages.purpose: The cafe cashier's selling screen: floor plan of tables and courts, then a tab's menu, basket, bill, payments, discounts, loyalty and splits. Search params ?tab=<uuid> and ?reservation=<uuid>.

components.name: Floor view and spot dialog
components.purpose: The cafe plan, court boards and other-open-tabs list the till opens on; a tap goes to a tab or asks via SpotDialog.

components.name: New order wizard
components.purpose: Stepped dialog (Name, Court booking, Review) that opens a counter tab or a booking bill through tab.open.

components.name: Category strip and item grid
components.purpose: Café categories (1-9) and menu tiles with ready / no tab / unavailable / out of stock looks; a plain click quick-adds.

components.name: Item sheet (size, modifiers, qty, note)
components.purpose: Dialog for items needing a choice: sizes with prices, modifier groups with deltas, a 1-99 quantity stepper and a 120-char kitchen note.

components.name: Line note dialog
components.purpose: The note button on a basket line: preset chips (drinks, food, service) plus a free line; the preview is the exact kitchen text.

components.name: Keyboard map and barcode wedge
components.purpose: F2/F4/F5/F6, /, ?, 1-9, arrows and Enter; USB scanner bursts recognised as member cards (TP-...).

components.name: Basket and Send to kitchen
components.purpose: Unsent lines for the selected tab with qty stepper, note, remove, Pick up / Bring to service choice, estimate and Send to kitchen (F2) via order.add_items.

components.name: Tab panel: lines, totals, actions
components.purpose: The selected tab: identity header, sent lines (change price / void), totals with tax, discounts, court fee, paid and the pinned pay footer.

components.name: Bring to... (order delivery)
components.purpose: Each sent order's row on the tab: Pick up, Bring to a table or a tonight court, or no table yet; saved with app.order_set_delivery (online only).

components.name: Payment dialog (cash / card) and shift gate
components.purpose: Cash with tendered, quick notes and change; Card records the approved amount; part payments; settle_tab via tab.settle with expected total; the till shift gate before tender.

components.name: Split bill (evenly / by item)
components.purpose: Even split via app.split_evenly and by-item via app.split_by_item; each share is taken as a cash or card payment through settle.

components.name: Charge to booking
components.purpose: Moves an open cafe tab onto a booking bill: tab.open on the booking (queued) then app.merge_tabs (online only).

components.name: Guest bill and receipt print
components.purpose: On-screen bill from the same totals the pay buttons use; Print sends an ESC/POS receipt via touch.print kind receipt, falling back to window.print.

components.name: Discounts at the till
components.purpose: Manager Discount (percent or IQD, manager PIN, adjustment.apply queued with the PIN in the payload) and the customer's own discount (0342, no PIN, online only).

components.name: Member on the bill (loyalty)
components.purpose: MemberAttach: scan or phone to attach (loyalty_identify, set_tab_customer), Use points, Rewards (incl. 0350 item rewards) and Undo; all online only.

components.name: Offline tabs
components.purpose: Tabs opened while disconnected (local:<idempotency key>), persisted to localStorage, with queued / settled-awaiting-sync / failed states and their own estimate-based pay panel.

components.name: Waiter calls
components.purpose: Unresolved waiter_calls on the service rail (and as a strip in the order view): On my way / Done via the queued waiter_call.action, with age escalation and old-call folding.

components.name: Scanned order slips
components.purpose: Handwritten slips photographed by a waiter (0238/0239): listed on the rail (strip in order view), reviewed against the photo, matched to the menu and sent to a table's tab (online only).

steps.expected: The item sheet opens instead of adding; the tile shows 'from <price>' and the more icon

steps.check: Right-click a quick-add tile
steps.expected: The item sheet opens for that item so qty and note can be set

steps.check: Focus a sold-out or out-of-stock tile with the arrow keys and press Enter, then right-click it

steps.check: As manager mark an item sold out (or paused for today), then look at its tile

steps.check: Count a required ingredient down to 0 on hand
steps.expected: Tiles of items needing it turn solid muted with 'Out of stock' and no price; legend shows; they clear when stock is received

steps.check: Change availability on the admin menu while the till is open

steps.check: Type 'lat' in the filter

steps.check: Check whether a shop (Touch Shop) category or product is on the cafe grid
steps.expected: No shop-kind category or its products appear; they sell only at the shop desk
steps.why: Shop and cafe items never share a bill (TAB_KIND_MISMATCH)

steps.check: Slow the network and open a tab with an uncached menu
steps.expected: 'Loading the menu...' with a skeleton of the same height shows; then tiles appear without the layout jumping

points.title: Item sheet (size, modifiers, qty, note): main flow

steps.check: Open an item with a required group (min 1) and choose nothing
steps.expected: Add is disabled and says '“<group>” needs between 1 and 1 choices.'

steps.check: In a single-choice group (max 1) press option A then option B
steps.expected: B replaces A (only one stays pressed); in a multi group with max 3 a fourth press does nothing

steps.check: Clear the quantity field completely, then type 0 and 150
steps.expected: Empty shows a faded '0' and Add is disabled; leading zeros are dropped and at most two digits are kept (max 99); + stops at 99 and - stops at 1
steps.why: A zero or huge quantity is a mistaken charge

steps.check: Check the group labels
steps.expected: Groups read 'Required' or 'Optional' plus 'up to N' when more than one may be picked; negative deltas show with a minus sign

steps.check: Press Escape or click outside the sheet
steps.expected: The sheet closes and nothing is added

steps.check: Press the note icon on a basket line, tap 'No ice' and 'Takeaway', type 'two straws', Save note
steps.expected: The preview reads 'The kitchen reads: No ice, Takeaway, two straws'; the line shows the note in italics and the note icon is tinted and renamed 'Edit note'

steps.check: Reopen the same note
steps.expected: No ice and Takeaway chips are lit and only two straws is in the free line (splitNote)
steps.why: Editing must not duplicate or lose note parts

steps.check: Open a note dialog and change nothing
steps.expected: Save note is disabled until something changes; Enter in the free line saves only when changed

steps.check: Press Clear then Save note
steps.expected: The note becomes empty: preview says 'No note - the line prints plain.' and the line's note disappears
steps.why: Removing a wrong instruction must be possible

steps.check: Type more than 120 characters in the free line
steps.expected: Input stops at 120 characters
steps.why: Overlong notes break the kitchen card

steps.check: Remove the line while its note dialog is open (via a second click path) or switch tabs
steps.expected: The note dialog closes rather than editing a line that no longer exists

points.title: Keyboard map and barcode wedge: main flow

steps.check: With lines in the basket press F2
steps.expected: The basket is sent exactly as pressing Send to kitchen
steps.why: Keyboard speed is a sold feature

steps.check: Press F6 anywhere, including inside the filter
steps.expected: The New order wizard opens
steps.why: New tabs must be one key away

steps.check: In the order view press 3, then /, type wat and Enter
steps.expected: Key 3 selects the third category and clears the filter; / focuses the filter; Enter adds Water when it is the only visible quick-add item and clears the filter

steps.check: Press ? (or the keyboard button)
steps.expected: 'Keyboard shortcuts' opens, listing every row from TILL_KEYMAP with the intro 'Money is only ever confirmed inside the payment dialog'
steps.why: Staff must be able to learn the keys

steps.check: With a dialog open (item sheet) type digits and letters
steps.expected: Digits and letters do not switch category or type into the filter; only F2/F4/F5/F6 still act
steps.why: Global keys must not steal input from dialogs

steps.check: On a selected server tab, scan a member card QR with the USB scanner (TP-<code>-<otp> + Enter)
steps.expected: The burst is not typed into the filter or quick-added; the Member field of the tab opens pre-filled with the scanned code
steps.why: Scans must not ring up random items

steps.check: Type a single digit by hand slowly (e.g. 2)
steps.expected: After ~50 ms the held digit is replayed as the category key 2 (no lost keystroke)
steps.why: Scanner detection must not break manual typing

points.title: Basket and Send to kitchen: main flow

steps.check: Add 2 lines to the basket of 'Table 4' and look at the basket heading
steps.expected: The heading reads 'Basket for Table 4 (n)' where n counts units, not lines; estimate equals the sum of line estimates in IQD
steps.why: The cashier must see which bill the order lands on

steps.check: Press Send to kitchen (F2)
steps.expected: 'Sending...' shows on the reserved line; the basket empties; the lines appear on the tab with server prices; a ticket appears on the KDS. No kitchen ticket is printed (KDS only)
steps.why: Orders that do not reach the kitchen are lost sales

steps.check: Press - on a line at qty 1, then x
steps.expected: - is disabled at 1 (it never deletes); x removes the line without asking
steps.why: A mis-aimed minus must not silently drop a drink

steps.check: Press Clear basket
steps.expected: All unsent lines go; Send is disabled with an empty basket
steps.why: Wrong orders must be easy to discard before sending

steps.check: With unsent lines, press Floor or another tab
steps.expected: A confirm 'Discard unsent items?' says 'The basket has N unsent line(s). Switching tabs discards them.'; Cancel keeps them
steps.why: Unsent items silently lost are unpaid food

steps.check: On a table tab, choose 'Pick up' and Send; on the same tab choose 'Bring to Table 4' and Send
steps.expected: The first order is sent with service pickup and the second deliver; each order row on the tab reads Pick up / Bring to Table 4, and the KDS card says the same
steps.why: Runners must know whether to carry the order (0351)

steps.check: On a counter tab (no table) look at the service control default
steps.expected: It starts on the server's default for that tab (counter tab = Pick up); 'Bring it to them' has no spot name
steps.why: Defaults must match what older tills sent

steps.check: Set Pick up on tab A, switch to tab B
steps.expected: Tab B starts on its own default, not on the choice made for tab A
steps.why: A carried-over choice sends food to the wrong place

steps.check: Make till_add_items refuse (e.g. an item becomes unavailable between add and send)
steps.expected: The basket keeps its lines and the status line shows the refusal, e.g. 'An item in the order is unavailable right now.' (ITEM_UNAVAILABLE)
steps.why: A refused order must not vanish from the screen

steps.check: Double-press Send quickly
steps.expected: Only one order is created (button busy while sending, idempotency key per send)
steps.why: Double orders waste food and overcharge

steps.check: On a counter tab with a sent 'bring it' order, look at the order row
steps.expected: The row is tinted amber 'Bring it: no table yet' with a primary 'Choose table' button
steps.why: Food with no destination goes cold at the pass

steps.check: Press Choose table, pick Table 6, Save
steps.expected: The row reads Bring to Table 6; the KDS card updates to Table 6

steps.check: Change a sent order to Pick up and Save
steps.expected: The row reads Pick up; the table/court choices are hidden while Pick up is selected
steps.why: Wrong service wastes a runner trip

steps.check: As a cashier, open Bring to... with live bookings tonight
steps.expected: A 'Courts tonight' list shows the bookings (time . court . guest); with none it reads 'No live bookings tonight.'
steps.why: Courtside delivery needs the booking list

steps.check: Look at an order that is already served/voided
steps.expected: Its row has no Change button (only sent, preparing, ready are editable)
steps.why: Editing closed orders confuses the kitchen

points.title: Payment dialog (cash / card) and shift gate: main flow

steps.expected: Record payment is disabled with 'Enter what the guest handed over.'

steps.component: Payment dialog (cash / card) and shift gate

points.title: Split bill (evenly / by item): main flow

steps.check: Reduce People from 3 to 2 after assigning lines to Person 3

steps.check: Set People to the limits

points.title: Discounts at the till: main flow

steps.check: Type 150 in Percent off

steps.check: Choose Percent 10, then switch to Amount (IQD)
steps.expected: The value resets to 10 (10 IQD) rather than keeping a percent meaning

steps.check: Enter a wrong PIN, then a cashier PIN

steps.check: As a cashier attached as the member on their own bill, open Customer discount
steps.expected: 'This is your own bill. A colleague has to give you a discount.' shows and nothing can be applied

points.title: Member on the bill (loyalty): main flow

steps.check: Press 'Member', type the guest's phone (07...) and Find member
steps.expected: The member chip shows name, tier and points balance; the tab customer is set
steps.why: Points earned on the wrong person are a complaint

steps.check: Type something that is neither a member code nor a phone
steps.expected: 'That isn't a member code or a phone number. Scan again, or type the whole number.'

steps.check: Use points with no recent card scan (attached by phone)
steps.expected: A 'Manager PIN' field appears with 'The member's card was not scanned just now...'; confirm stays disabled until a 4+ digit PIN
steps.why: Points spend only with proof the member is present (0308)

steps.check: Enter more points than the balance, fewer than the minimum, or use points on a fully paid bill
steps.expected: Blocks read 'More than the N points the member has.', 'At least N points are used at a time.', 'Nothing is left to pay on this bill.'

steps.check: Open Rewards with a member below a reward cost
steps.expected: That reward's Use is disabled with 'Not enough points'

steps.check: Attach a member who is a staff member
steps.expected: set_tab_customer answers PIN_GRANT_REQUIRED and a staff dialog asks for ANOTHER manager's PIN; their own PIN is not accepted
steps.why: Staff must not earn or spend on their own bills unchecked

steps.check: Raise a call from a table QR with the till open
steps.expected: It appears at once with a chime: Table N block, reason (e.g. 'Wants the bill'), age 'just now', buttons 'On my way' and 'Done'; the header counts it on a red badge
steps.why: Guests waiting for the bill is lost turnover

steps.check: Leave a raised call 2 minutes, then 5 minutes
steps.expected: The age text turns amber at 2 min and red 'Waiting 5 min' at 5 min; un-acked calls older than 5 min re-alarm every 60 s
steps.why: Escalation keeps guests from being forgotten

steps.check: Press 'On my way'
steps.expected: The call reads 'On the way' with the staff label and only Done remains; the guest's phone says it is acknowledged
steps.why: Guests need to know someone is coming

steps.check: Press Done
steps.expected: The call leaves the list and the table loses its calling mark

steps.check: Upload a slip from the staff phone with the till open
steps.expected: It appears under 'Scanned orders' with one chime, status Uploaded then Reading then Read (refetch every 4 s while reading), and a '<n> waiting' badge
steps.why: Slips not seen are orders not made

steps.check: Open a read slip
steps.expected: The review shows the photo, each read line matched to a menu item/size/count with its match source, the read table, and 'Send to kitchen'
steps.why: The cashier must check the AI reading against the photo

steps.check: Leave a line unmatched or missing a required option
steps.expected: Send is disabled naming the first problem (item, quantity or the missing option group)
steps.why: Sending a half-read order makes the wrong food

steps.check: Send a slip for a table with no open tab
steps.expected: The server opens a tab on that table and adds the lines; the slip moves to the sent-today fold with Sent by <name>
steps.why: Slip orders must land on a bill

steps.check: Send a slip for a table with two open tabs without choosing one
steps.expected: Send is disabled until a tab is chosen ('choose_tab'); if it changed meanwhile the server refuses TAB_AMBIGUOUS and the tabs refetch
steps.why: Wrong-tab orders bill the wrong party

steps.check: Press 'Set aside' (reject) and confirm
steps.expected: The slip leaves the waiting list and is listed as rejected today

steps.check: Press 'Read again' on a failed slip
steps.expected: A new reading runs; when it finishes the lines are replaced (asks first if the cashier edited them: Use new reading / Keep mine)
steps.why: Re-reads must not silently overwrite edits

steps.check: In the order view with waiting slips
steps.expected: A one-line strip reads 'Scanned orders waiting: n' with 'Open', which opens the oldest waiting slip
steps.why: Slips must reach the cashier on every view

points.title: Till (cafe cashier): money and totals (1 of 3)

steps.check: Open an item with sizes, choose Large, add an extra (+500 IQD), qty 2, note, then Add
steps.expected: The basket gains one line with Large, the modifier name, the note in italics, and estimate = 2 x (Large price + 500) IQD
steps.why: Wrong size or extras price the bill wrong

steps.check: On a tab with something due press F4, then F5
steps.expected: F4 opens the Cash dialog and F5 the Card dialog; no money is recorded until Record payment or Enter inside the dialog
steps.why: A stray key must never take money

steps.check: Press F4 on a settled tab, a tab with 0 due, or while a payment is queued
steps.expected: Nothing opens (hotkey gate: settled, held, due <= 0)
steps.why: Double payments on settled tabs are costly

steps.check: Compare the basket estimate with the line totals the tab shows after sending
steps.expected: They match unless a price changed; the tab figures are the server's (till_add_items prices them), labelled only as estimate in the basket
steps.why: The bill must use server prices, not a stale cache

steps.check: Open a tab with 3 lines of 5,000 / 7,500 / 12,000 IQD and no discounts (tax exclusive 0%)
steps.expected: Subtotal 24,500 IQD, Total 24,500 IQD; Cash and Card enabled; integer IQD with no decimals
steps.why: The total is what the guest pays

steps.check: Set a 10% active tax group on a category (tax_inclusive off) and open a tab with 10,000 IQD of it

steps.check: Switch the venue to tax inclusive and reopen the same tab
steps.expected: The row reads 'Tax (included)' with 909 IQD (10,000 x 1000/11000 rounded) and the Total stays 10,000 IQD
steps.why: Inclusive tax must not be charged twice

steps.check: Apply a manager discount larger than the subtotal
steps.expected: Discount is capped at the subtotal; Total never goes below 0 and Due never negative
steps.why: A negative bill is a cash leak

steps.check: Open a booking tab (court fee owed 30,000) with 10,000 of drinks
steps.expected: 'Court fee . <Court>' 30,000 shows between tax and Total; Total 40,000; until app.booking_bill answers, the court row and Total show a dash and Cash, Card, Split and Bill are held with 'Loading the court fee...'

steps.check: Open a drinks tab on a booking whose court was paid on an earlier bill
steps.expected: The court row reads 'Paid on an earlier bill' and nothing is added

steps.check: Pay part of a 40,000 tab (15,000 cash)

steps.check: Press a sent line, then Void, enter a manager PIN and reason

steps.check: Double-click Record payment

steps.check: On a 100,000 IQD tab press Split bill, keep Evenly, set People to 3

steps.check: Take Person 1 by Cash and Person 2 by Card

steps.check: Assign every line and press Work out shares on a tab with a discount and a court fee

points.title: Till (cafe cashier): money and totals (3 of 3)

steps.check: Compare the bill Total with the tab panel Total

steps.check: While a booking tab court fee is loading, look at Bill

steps.check: Scan a member card, then press Use points with the default amount

steps.check: Open Bill on a settled tab

points.title: Till (cafe cashier): Who can and cannot use it

points.title: Till (cafe cashier): With no internet (1 of 3)

steps.check: Offline after a restart, open a tab and look at the grid

pages.name: Open tabs
pages.purpose: The board of every open tab on the floor (cafe, booking and web-order tabs) with search, sort, open, merge and removal of empty tabs. Used by cashiers and management at the till.

components.name: Open tabs table
components.purpose: Lists each open tab with Tab, Open for, Total so far and actions; groups booking tabs by court.

components.name: Remove an empty tab
components.purpose: Removes a tab with nothing on it, with a confirm and a reason (tab.cancel, queued).

components.name: Merge tabs
components.purpose: Moves everything from one tab into another (merge_tabs, online only by decision).

components.name: Open tab from the board
components.purpose: Opens the new-tab dialog from the board and jumps into the till with the new tab.

steps.check: Open three tabs (table 4, a booking tab on Court 2, a named walk-in) and view the board
steps.expected: All three rows appear with their labels; the booking tab sits under its court group "Court 2" with a count and the court fee note under the table
steps.why: Staff need to find a tab fast

steps.check: Type a table number, a court name and a guest name into "Search table, court or guest…"

steps.expected: Rows reorder by the chosen key and the choice persists while the screen stays open
steps.why: Sorting helps a cashier scan the floor
