steps.expected: The tab row carries the "Web order" badge
steps.why: Web orders must be noticed and served

steps.check: Press "Open" on a row
steps.expected: The till opens with that tab selected (/till?tab=<id>)

pages.name: Tab corrections
pages.purpose: The money corrections on a selected till tab that the till selling checks do not cover in depth: refund (management only, manager PIN), change price (price override), void after send edge cases and promotions. Refund, override and void ride the durable queue; promotions are online only.

components.name: Refund

components.name: Void a sent line

components.name: Promotion

pages.name: Till shift
pages.purpose: The rail row and dialogs for a cashier/desk/shop person to start a shift with a counted float, end it with a blind count signed by their PIN or a manager PIN, and the payment gate that asks for a shift first. All shift writes are online only.

components.name: Start my shift
components.purpose: Opens a shift with a counted opening float (open_till_shift).

components.name: End my shift / close a shift
components.purpose: Blind count, then sign with own PIN (close_till_shift) or a manager PIN (verify_manager_pin + close_till_shift_for).

components.name: Payment gate
components.purpose: Before a cashier takes payment, asks for a shift (start, close the other person, or end elsewhere). The cashier-side gate variants are in OP.TILL.PAYMENT; these are the remaining ones.

components.name: Sign out and lock with a shift open
components.purpose: Asks before leaving with my shift open: End my shift / Sign out anyway / Cancel.

components.name: Shift report
components.purpose: The list of shifts by day, person and station with float, expected, counted and difference, exportable.

pages.name: Kitchen display
pages.purpose: The wall-mounted, navless, dark ticket board for the bar and the kitchen: every cafe ticket from the till and the guest website in arrival order, bumped Start -> Ready -> Complete by touch or keyboard. Falls back to the cafe till's LAN feed when the cloud is down.

components.name: Board header
components.purpose: Title, centred clock, open count, realtime pill, My tasks and the way out.

components.name: Ticket arrival
components.purpose: kitchen_board read, the private kds broadcast topic (ticket_created, ticket_status, item_ready), chime and unseen count.

components.name: Ticket card
components.purpose: One ticket: key digit, pick-up / no-table marks, tag, age band, status line, items with sizes, modifiers and notes.

components.name: Ticket bump (Start / Ready / Complete)
components.purpose: set_ticket_status through the durable queue (ticket.status), optimistic, transition table queued -> preparing|ready, preparing -> ready, ready -> completed.

components.name: Item ready ticks
components.purpose: Per-line ready checkboxes, server state since 0061 (set_order_item_ready, direct RPC, online only).

components.name: Sound and stale alarms
components.purpose: Turn on sound strip, ticket chime, stale threshold 90 s in Queued, repeat alarm every 30 s, stale banner.

components.name: Keyboard bumping
components.purpose: Keys 1-9 select, arrows move, Up/Down move items, Space ticks, S/R/C bump, Esc clears, ? opens guide.

components.name: LAN fallback (offline kitchen)
components.purpose: When the cloud read fails in Electron, the board renders tickets the till pushes over the LAN websocket (port 47810, PSK bearer) and carries bumps back to the till's queue.

steps.check: Sign in as prep on a station set up as Kitchen screen
steps.expected: The app opens straight on /kds (homeRoute) with the dark board, no rail, header "Kitchen display", a centred clock, the connection pill and the key legend at the bottom

steps.check: On a production (kiosk) KDS station on macOS, look at the top corners while the board is up
steps.expected: No traffic-light buttons and no OS titlebar show over the header (pushChromeless while the navless workspace is up); the window cannot be minimised
steps.why: A wall screen must not be closed or hidden by a stray tap

steps.check: Sign in as head_barista and as head_chef on the same KDS station and compare the tickets shown
steps.expected: Both see the same full list (bar drinks and kitchen food together). There is no bar-only or kitchen-only filter by role: kitchen_board takes no station argument. Record this as a known gap if separate bar and kitchen screens are expected at launch
steps.why: A barista may start food tickets or miss drinks among food

steps.check: Load the board with three open tickets and one completed in the last two minutes
steps.expected: Header reads "3 open" (completed tickets are not counted); the clock sits in the middle column and does not move when the count changes from 9 to 10
steps.why: The open count is the kitchen's workload at a glance

steps.check: Watch the connection pill on a healthy network
steps.expected: Pill shows "Connecting" (amber dot) then "Live" (green dot)
steps.why: Staff need to know whether new tickets arrive instantly

steps.check: Sign in as a barista (has /tasks) and look at the header
steps.expected: "My tasks" pill shows; with pending steps it reads "My tasks (N)" with a green ring; pressing it opens /tasks without the rail, and /tasks leads back to the board
steps.why: Bar and kitchen roles have no other way to reach their tasks

steps.check: Sign in as head_chef with team ideas waiting for review
steps.expected: My tasks count = steps to do + ideas to review (head roles only); a barista's count excludes ideas
steps.why: Heads must see ideas waiting on them

steps.check: As a prep-only account, look for any way off the board
steps.expected: No "Leave kitchen display" button and no rail: the board is navless
steps.why: A wall screen should have nothing to get lost in

steps.check: As a manager open /kds and press "Leave kitchen display"
steps.expected: With one other workspace it lands on that workspace home; with several it opens the workspace switcher in the light palette (no invisible titles on the black background)
steps.why: Staff covering the pass must be able to return to their work

steps.check: Press the "Guide" pill at the end of the key legend, or press ?
steps.expected: The workspace guide opens as a dialog; while it is open the board keys (1, S, Space) do nothing to the tickets
steps.why: Help must not bump tickets by accident

steps.check: Send an order from the cafe till ("Send to kitchen") while the board is open
steps.expected: A new card rises in at the end of the list within about a second and a ticket chime plays; its tag shows the table or tab name and source "Cafe cashier"
steps.why: Orders that do not reach the kitchen are not made

steps.check: Place a guest QR/web order for a table
steps.expected: The card arrives with the globe icon and "QR"/web source and the table tag; it chimes like a till ticket
steps.why: Web orders are paid-for guest orders

steps.check: Reload the board with tickets already open
steps.expected: Cards appear in arrival order without the rise animation (only tickets that arrive after first paint rise)
steps.why: Motion must mean something new arrived

steps.check: Minimise focus (click another window) and send two orders, then focus the board again
steps.expected: Window title reads "(2) Kitchen display · Touch" while unfocused and resets to "Kitchen display · Touch" on focus; chimes play for both
steps.why: A hidden board must still signal new work

steps.check: Void a line on the till after it was sent
steps.expected: The voided line disappears from the card on the next update; a ticket voided entirely leaves the board

steps.check: Make a shop sale at the Touch Shop desk
steps.expected: No ticket appears on the KDS (a shop sale makes no ticket on the server and is skipped from the LAN feed)
steps.why: Rackets and balls are not kitchen work

steps.check: Leave the board with completed tickets for three minutes
steps.expected: A completed ticket stays faded for two minutes (COMPLETED_LINGER_MS, server window too) then drops off without a reload
steps.why: Finished tickets must clear the pass

steps.check: Send an order for table 7 with a size, two modifiers (one x2) and a note "no sugar"
steps.expected: Card tag "Table 7"; item line "1× Latte (Large)", modifiers line "2× Extra shot · Oat milk" in muted text, note chip with the note icon reading "no sugar"
steps.why: Wrong or missing modifiers mean a remade order

steps.check: Send an order on a booking tab for Court 2 as cashier, and view it as cashier/manager and as chef
steps.expected: Tag shows the court name; the guest name after " · " shows only for the till and management (kitchen roles get the court only)
steps.why: Guest names are not the kitchen's business

steps.check: On the till choose Pick up for a counter order (0351)
steps.expected: The card leads with a filled "PICK UP" mark before the tag
steps.why: The guest is called to the counter instead of the runner walking it out

steps.check: Send a counter order to be brought over with no table attached (0352), then attach table 4 on the till

steps.why: Food must not be walked out to nowhere

steps.check: Watch a ticket with no target over 11 minutes
steps.expected: Band has no fill and "On time" under 5:00, amber "Getting late" 5:00-9:59, red "Late" from 10:00; the age reads m:ss
steps.why: The colour tells the kitchen what to cook first

steps.check: Send an item whose ticket target is 4 minutes
steps.expected: The band turns red "Late" at 4:00, not 10:00; hovering the age shows "Target 4 min"
steps.why: Fast items must not hide behind the generic threshold

steps.check: Set the KDS PC clock two minutes ahead of the server
steps.expected: A brand-new ticket reads 0:00 "On time" and never shows a negative age (clamped)
steps.why: Clock skew must not paint fresh tickets red

steps.check: Bump a ticket from a Telegram tap (0032) and view the card
steps.expected: The meta line shows the actor label (e.g. "Telegram: Ahmed") truncated, after the status and source
steps.why: The kitchen sees who moved a ticket

steps.check: Read a card with three items from three metres
steps.expected: Item names are the biggest text on the card; one-item tickets show no "0 of 1 ready" line; multi-item tickets show "N of M ready"
steps.why: The kitchen reads the board through steam

points.title: Ticket bump (Start / Ready / Complete): main flow

steps.check: On a queued ticket press "Start" (S), then "Ready" (R), then "Complete" (C)
steps.expected: Status line goes Queued -> Preparing -> Ready -> Completed instantly (optimistic); Start sits in the left column, Ready then Complete in the right, so the button under the hand never jumps
steps.why: This is the kitchen's whole job flow

steps.check: On a queued ticket press "Ready" without Start
steps.expected: Allowed (queued -> ready); the card shows Ready with a Complete button

steps.check: Look for a way to un-bump (Recall / Undo) a ticket marked Complete by mistake
steps.expected: There is none on the board: a completed ticket stays faded two minutes with no actions and then leaves. Confirm with Majed whether launch needs a recall; otherwise staff re-send from the till
steps.why: A mis-tap hides a ticket that is not served

steps.check: Watch a stale ticket after pressing Start
steps.expected: The alarm ring and the repeating alarm stop for that ticket as soon as it leaves Queued
steps.why: Alarms must stop when work starts

steps.check: Tick two of three items on a ticket
steps.expected: Ticked lines strike through in muted colour with the note still legible; footer reads "2 of 3 ready"
steps.why: The pass sees what is still missing

steps.check: Tick an item on KDS 1 and watch KDS 2
steps.expected: KDS 2 shows the tick within a second (item_ready broadcast) and after a reload the tick is still there

steps.check: Press Complete on a ticket with unticked items
steps.expected: Allowed; ticks are informational and do not block Complete
steps.why: Ticks must not stop a bump

points.title: Sound and stale alarms: main flow

steps.check: Open the board in a browser (not Electron)

steps.check: Open the board in the Electron KDS station

steps.check: Leave a ticket in Queued for 90 seconds
steps.expected: At 90 s the card gains the red inset alarm ring, its status reads "Waiting too long", an alarm sound plays once and the red banner "⚠ N tickets need attention — not started in time" appears without shifting the grid

steps.check: Leave the stale ticket another minute
steps.expected: The alarm repeats every 30 s per stale ticket; three tickets going stale together sound one alarm, not three

steps.check: Turn the KDS PC volume to zero
steps.expected: Visuals still show stale ring and banner; note that the app cannot tell the volume is off

steps.check: Press 2, then S
steps.expected: Ticket 2 is selected with a visible ring and DOM focus, and S starts it

steps.check: Press Right/Left arrows, Down twice, then Space
steps.expected: Selection moves between tickets; Down moves the item cursor; Space ticks the item under the cursor (Space with no cursor lands on the first item first)

steps.check: Press C on a queued ticket

steps.check: Bump the selected ticket to Complete and wait for it to drop off

steps.check: Press Ctrl+S or Alt+R

steps.check: Connect to port 47810 with a wrong PSK (e.g. websocat with a bad bearer) or send a malformed frame

steps.check: In LAN mode with no tickets

steps.check: In LAN mode check ages and colours

steps.expected: The order queues on the till; the KDS stays on the cloud board, so the LAN frame is not shown and the ticket appears only when the till's queue uploads. Record the delay and confirm with Majed

points.title: Kitchen display: Flaky or slow network, backend down

steps.check: Throttle the network and open the board
steps.expected: Three dark skeleton cards on the board grid with the key legend visible; no count in the header until loaded
steps.why: Loading must not look like an empty kitchen

steps.check: In browser (non-Electron) mode block the API and open /kds
steps.expected: Error panel "Tickets could not be loaded" with "Check this screen's network connection. The board keeps trying by itself every 30 seconds." and a Retry button that refetches

steps.check: Make set_order_item_ready fail (block the API) and tick an item
steps.expected: The tick rolls back for that one item and the error shows in the red notice row
steps.why: A tick that did not save must not look saved

points.title: Kitchen display: Café cashier (LAN peer) unreachable

steps.check: Pull the KDS network cable (cloud and LAN both down for this PC) and press Start
steps.expected: In the Electron app the board switches to LAN mode; with no till connection the bump goes nowhere (sendLanStatus returns false and nothing on screen says it failed). Record whether the card stays Queued
steps.why: A silently lost bump leaves the pass out of step

steps.check: In LAN mode look at a ticket's items
steps.expected: No checkboxes: a dot sits where the box was and the footer says "Ticking items comes back when the connection does."

steps.check: In LAN mode close the cafe till app (or unplug its LAN) for a minute, then bring it back
steps.expected: KDS client retries with backoff (2 s doubling to 30 s) and reconnects on its own; tickets resync via snapshot. While the till is down nothing new arrives and no on-screen message says the till is unreachable
steps.why: The kitchen may think it is just quiet

steps.check: In LAN mode, with nobody signed in on the till, press Start on the KDS
steps.expected: The till refuses ("till has no staff session") and the bump is not queued; the KDS card does not change. Check that the kitchen notices
steps.why: Bumps need a signed-in till to be attributed

steps.check: Register a KDS station at branch 2 and send an order on a branch 1 till
steps.expected: The branch 2 board does not show the branch 1 ticket (kitchen_board reads the station's branch via visible_venue_ids)
steps.why: Kitchens of two branches must never cook each other's orders

steps.check: Switch the language to Arabic on the KDS
steps.expected: Board mirrors right-to-left; "Kitchen display", age words (On time / Getting late / Late), Start / Ready / Complete and the legend read in Arabic; the clock, table numbers and m:ss ages stay isolated (bdi) and readable

steps.check: Switch the Windows keyboard layout to Arabic and press the S key and the 3 key
steps.expected: S still starts the selected ticket (physical key code), 3 selects ticket 3, Arabic-Indic digits also work; under RTL the left/right arrows are mirrored
steps.why: Arabic layouts are common in the kitchen

steps.check: Open /kds on a 1280x720 screen with six tickets
steps.expected: Cards flow into as many 22rem columns as fit, nothing overlaps, the legend stays on one or two lines and the board scrolls vertically

steps.check: Seed 60 open tickets and leave the board running for 30 minutes
steps.expected: Board stays responsive (the clock ticks every 5 s, no visible stutter when bumping), memory does not climb steadily, only the first nine cards carry a digit key
steps.why: A busy night must not freeze the pass

steps.check: With an operator update downloaded, look at the board
steps.expected: A floating update pill appears (there is no rail on the kitchen screen) and the board keeps working until restarted
steps.why: Kitchen stations must take updates without losing the board

steps.check: Block the realtime websocket only
steps.expected: Pill turns "Disconnected" in red; the board still re-reads every 30 s (BOARD_REFETCH_MS) so new tickets appear within 30 s
steps.why: Realtime is not the only way tickets arrive

steps.check: With the board idle and no realtime traffic, wait for a ticket to cross 90 s
steps.expected: It still goes stale (10 s reconcile timer), no message needed
steps.why: Alarms must not depend on traffic

steps.check: With no tickets open, open the board
steps.expected: Empty state with a green tick: "No tickets — all caught up" and "Orders sent from the website or the café cashier appear here the moment they are placed."; no "0 open" in the header
steps.why: An empty board must not look broken

steps.check: Close the KDS app, send three orders from the till, wait five minutes, then reopen the KDS
steps.expected: The till shows only "Order sent." (it never shows kitchen state); all three tickets wait server-side and appear on reopen with their true age, already red/stale with the alarm
steps.why: Orders must not be lost when the kitchen screen is off

steps.check: Leave a ticket open overnight
steps.expected: Age reads "{h}h {m}m" past an hour and "{d}d" past a day, never a four-digit minute count
steps.why: A forgotten ticket must be readable at a glance

steps.check: Bump the same ticket to Ready on two KDS screens at the same moment
steps.expected: One wins; the other gets INVALID_TRANSITION ("That status change is not allowed.") shown inline in the red notice row (never only a toast) and its card rolls back, then self-heals on the refetch
steps.why: Two screens must not corrupt a ticket

steps.check: While one bump is in flight, bump a different ticket
steps.expected: Both cards move; a refusal of the first restores only that ticket and does not undo the second
steps.why: A rollback must not undo other work

steps.check: Bump three tickets while offline (Electron, via the till over LAN), then restore the internet
steps.expected: The till's queue replays each ticket.status after the order it bumps; once the board reads the cloud again the cards show the same states, none bounced back to Queued
steps.why: Offline bumps must reconcile, not reset

steps.check: In LAN mode press Start then Ready on a LAN ticket
steps.expected: The till accepts it onto its own queue and echoes status.update; every KDS on the LAN shows the new state; after internet returns the server ticket matches
steps.why: Bumps made offline must not be lost

steps.check: Bump a ticket offline that someone voids on another station before reconnect
steps.expected: On replay the bump is refused and a refusal toast appears on the station that owns the queued write (QueueFailureToasts) and on Day close; the board shows the server state
steps.why: Refused writes must be visible, not silent

steps.check: Restart the KDS app in the middle of an outage
steps.expected: On reconnect to the till it receives a ticket.snapshot of up to 500 of today's kitchen tickets and redraws them with their states
steps.why: A reboot must not empty the board

steps.check: Take a desk-mode or shop-mode station offline and place a cafe order from it
steps.expected: That order never reaches the KDS over LAN (only a till-mode station runs the LAN server); it appears only after the station reconnects and uploads
steps.why: Café orders taken outside the till have no offline kitchen path

pages.name: Touch Shop till (Sell)
pages.purpose: The shop desk's cashier: scan or tap shop products, the basket adds up, Cash or Card takes the payment on the spot through the durable queue (one shop tab per sale), the receipt prints. Used by shop_staff on the shop PC; management can open it.

components.name: Product grid and scanner
components.purpose: Shop sections as filter chips, searchable tiles per size from the cached till menu, USB barcode scanner (BarcodeWedge).

components.name: Sale (basket)
components.purpose: Lines with plus, minus and remove, shelf-price total estimate, Clear sale.

components.name: Cash / Card sale
components.purpose: open_tab kind shop (label = time) + order.add_items shop + tab.settle, all QUEUED writes; PaymentPane with the till-shift gate.

components.name: Member on a shop sale
components.purpose: Member button or a TP- card scan identifies the member before the sale; set_tab_customer (online only), then a step with Use points, Rewards and the member discount.

components.name: Unfinished sales
components.purpose: Shop tabs open or awaiting payment, with Take payment to finish them.

components.name: Receipt after every sale
components.purpose: PaidReceipt -> BillView autoPrint (thermal receipt via touch.print kind receipt, browser print dialog fallback).

components.name: Sales reward hints
components.purpose: shop_reward_info: percent, per-tile "You earn", basket and month earnings (0355).

components.name: Supplier price watch crawler
components.purpose: Mounted in the signed-in shell; on a configured shop station with a /shop role signed in it reads due supplier links 20 s after start then hourly via touch.fetchSupplierPage and reports with record_shop_supplier_price.

points.title: Product grid and scanner: main flow

steps.check: Look at the grid with two shop sections and a product with two sizes
steps.expected: Chips "All", then the shop sections in their order; tiles name the size only where a product has several ("Racket X · Pro"); no cafe item ever appears
steps.why: Selling café items at the shop breaks both tills

steps.check: Type part of a name, a SKU, then a barcode into "Search by name, SKU or barcode…"
steps.expected: Tiles narrow to matching sizes each time (English or Arabic names)

steps.check: Scan a product barcode with the USB scanner
steps.expected: One unit is added to the Sale and the search box is cleared; a SKU typed by the scanner also matches (case-insensitive)
steps.why: Scanning is the main way to sell

steps.check: Scan a code no product has
steps.expected: Refusal message "No product has the code {code}." above the tiles; nothing is added
steps.why: A wrong scan must not add a wrong item

steps.check: Scan while the payment dialog or a PIN prompt is open
steps.expected: Nothing is added to the basket behind the dialog
steps.why: Scans must not ring up items unseen

steps.check: Mark a product sold out or switch it off in the menu
steps.expected: Its tile is greyed with "Out of stock" and cannot be tapped
steps.why: Selling what is not there causes refunds

points.title: Supplier price watch crawler: main flow

steps.check: Sign in as shop_staff on the shop PC with three supplier links set, wait 30 s
steps.expected: Each due link is read one at a time about 3 s apart; on Products each shows "Checked {time}. Price read: {price}."
steps.why: Owners rely on fresh supplier prices

steps.check: Have a supplier change a price to one the shop does not sell at, then wait for the hourly pass
steps.expected: A toast on whatever page is open: "A supplier changed a price. Open Products to apply it." (or "{count} supplier prices changed..."); the owner and the branch shop staff get a push naming the product only, never the price
steps.why: Price changes must reach the people who act

steps.check: Sign in as manager on the shop PC
steps.expected: The crawler runs (manager may open /shop) but managers get no push (owner and shop_staff only)

steps.check: Link a page priced in USD, a page with a size range, and a home page
steps.expected: "The page is not priced in Iraqi dinars.", "The page shows more than one price..." and "No price found on this page." respectively; no price is applied
steps.why: A guessed price would be applied as a selling price

steps.check: Restart the shop PC twice within 10 minutes
steps.expected: Links read less than 30 minutes ago are not read again
steps.why: Suppliers must not see bursts from one PC

points.title: Touch Shop till (Sell): money and totals

steps.check: Add item A (25,000 IQD) twice and item B (7,500 IQD) once
steps.expected: Lines "A 50,000 IQD" (qty 2) and "B 7,500 IQD"; Total 57,500 IQD; "3 items · At the shelf price. The receipt shows what was charged."

steps.check: Press minus on a qty-1 line, and the x on another line
steps.expected: The line is removed at zero; the total recalculates at once

steps.check: With tax configured as exclusive, compare the basket total with the amount on the payment
steps.expected: The basket shows the shelf-price estimate; the payment asks the server total (tax and rounding) read after the order is sent; the difference is explained by the estimate note
steps.why: Customers must be charged the server total

steps.check: With a shift open, basket 57,500 IQD, press Cash, tender 60,000 and settle
steps.expected: Payment pane asks 57,500 IQD; after settle "Change: 2,500 IQD" shows and the receipt opens; the drawer log shows a cash payment of 57,500 with change 2,500
steps.why: Cash must reconcile at the drawer count

steps.check: Press Card for a 32,000 IQD basket and settle
steps.expected: Card payment of 32,000 IQD recorded, no tender or change fields; trying cash-given on card gives "Cash given and change are for cash payments only."

steps.check: Pay part of a sale (amount less than due), then the rest
steps.expected: After the part payment the pane stays open with the remaining due recomputed from the server (total - paid); the second payment settles it; two payments show on the receipt
steps.why: Split payments must add up exactly

steps.check: As shop_staff press "Member", identify a member, then press Cash
steps.expected: Member chip shows with the pending note; after Cash the member step modal opens with the total, the member's standing discount applied by itself, Use points and Rewards; Continue opens the payment with the due recomputed
steps.why: Members must earn and redeem at the shop

steps.check: Redeem 5,000 IQD of points on a 40,000 IQD sale in the member step
steps.expected: Payment asks 35,000 IQD; receipt shows the points line
steps.why: Redemptions must reduce the charge exactly

steps.check: Press Cash, then close the payment pane without paying
steps.expected: The sale appears under "Unfinished sales" ("Rung up but not paid...") labelled with its time; "Take payment" reopens it with the due read from the server
steps.why: Unpaid sales hold the day close

steps.check: Compare the receipt total with the drawer entry and the Day close Shop block
steps.expected: Same IQD amount in all three

steps.check: Owner sets the sales reward to 10%, shop_staff opens /shop
steps.expected: Each tile shows "You earn {amount}" (price x 10% rounded down), the basket "You earn {amount} on this sale", the header "This month you earned {amount} from {sales} of shop sales"

steps.check: Put 3 units at 9,999 IQD in the basket at 10%
steps.expected: Basket reward = floor(29,997 x 10 / 100) = 2,999 IQD (rounded down per line, as the server does)
steps.why: Wage maths must match the shown estimate

steps.check: Sign in as shop_staff on a station set up as Touch Shop desk
steps.expected: Lands on /shop "Sell" with the lead "Scan a barcode or tap a product. Every sale is paid here, on the spot.", the product grid, the Sale panel and Cash / Card buttons

steps.check: As shop_staff use the rail
steps.expected: Rail lists Sell, Drawer, Stock, Goods in, Counts, Products, Suppliers in that order and nothing outside the shop
steps.why: The shop assistant holds this and nothing else

steps.check: Press "Clear sale" and confirm
steps.expected: Confirm "Clear this sale? Nothing has been charged yet." then the basket empties; Cancel keeps it

steps.check: Tender less than due in cash
steps.expected: "Tendered amount is less than the amount due." and the sale is not settled
steps.why: Short payments must not close a sale

steps.check: Make a 3-item shop sale and look on the KDS and the cafe Open tabs board
steps.expected: No kitchen ticket is created; the shop tab is not on the cafe board
steps.why: Shop and cafe flows stay separate

steps.check: Scan a member card (TP-...) instead of a barcode
steps.expected: The member field opens pre-filled and looks the member up; nothing is added to the basket
steps.why: Card scans must not be read as products

steps.check: Sign in in turn as shop_staff, manager and owner on /shop
steps.expected: All three see the Member button (attachMember includes shop_staff); every role that can open /shop can attach a member
steps.why: Shop staff must be able to serve members

steps.check: Complete an online sale on the shop PC with its printer on
steps.expected: The receipt "Touch Shop · {time}" prints once automatically on the thermal printer, showing lines, totals and payments in IQD; "Next sale" closes it

steps.check: Re-render the receipt (wait for a background refetch)
steps.expected: It does not print a second time

steps.check: Sign in as owner, then set the percent to 0
steps.expected: Owner sees no reward hints (earns none); at 0% nobody sees them

points.title: Touch Shop till (Sell): Who can and cannot use it

steps.check: Sign in as cashier, court_desk, waiter or a kitchen role and type /shop or /shop/products
steps.expected: Role refusal on every /shop page; the rail has no Shop entry for them
steps.why: Shop money and prices are not theirs

steps.check: Owner blocks /shop for a shop_staff person in Staff Access, then that person signs in
steps.expected: Every /shop page shows the blocked-page notice

steps.check: Sign out at the shop PC mid-pass
steps.expected: The pass stops before the next page; nothing more is reported

points.title: Touch Shop till (Sell): With no internet

steps.check: Go offline and reload /shop
steps.expected: The grid still shows from the cached menu and products can be scanned and tapped
steps.why: The shop keeps selling during outages

steps.check: Disconnect the shop PC and sell a 15,000 IQD item for cash
steps.expected: The sale goes onto the local queue (local: tab), the pane shows due 15,000 (shelf price), and after settle the "Paid" box says "Saved on this PC. It goes through when the connection is back." and prints NO receipt
steps.why: The shop must keep trading offline, and the guest gets no false receipt

steps.check: Go offline, attach a member and press Cash
steps.expected: The sale goes through without the member (no server tab to attach to) and no member step shows; confirm the shop assistant knows points were not earned
steps.why: Members may complain about missing points

steps.check: Go offline and look at Unfinished sales
steps.expected: The list keeps the last read (it is an online read every 30 s); Take payment fails with the network message
steps.why: Staff must know it needs the connection

steps.check: Turn the shop PC's network off at the hourly mark
steps.expected: The pass is skipped (navigator offline) and waits for the next hour; nothing is reported as an error
steps.why: Offline must not mark every link failed

points.title: Touch Shop till (Sell): Flaky or slow network, backend down

steps.check: Settle online but with a slow server (over 8 s)
steps.expected: mutate returns queued: the Paid box shows the queued message and no receipt; the sale settles when the queue acks. Reprint from the drawer/tab afterwards
steps.why: A slow line must not make a sale vanish

steps.check: Make set_tab_customer fail (block the API after the tab opens)
steps.expected: The error shows and the payment opens without the member; the sale is not lost
steps.why: A loyalty failure must not block a sale

steps.check: Make shop_reward_info fail
steps.expected: No reward hints show (never "0"); selling works normally
steps.why: A reward read failure must not block selling

steps.check: Switch to Arabic on /shop
steps.expected: Mirrors right-to-left; product names show in Arabic, prices format as IQD with consistent digits, the quantity and the time labels of unfinished sales stay left-to-right

steps.check: Print a receipt in Arabic
steps.expected: Arabic names render correctly on the thermal print (rendered as an image) and the layout is right-to-left

steps.check: Open /shop on the cafe till station as manager and sell one item
steps.expected: The sale works (no station-kind check on /shop) and the payment lands in the drawer of the shift open on THAT till; verify on the drawer that shop cash did not end up in the cafe drawer unnoticed
steps.why: Shop and cafe cash must reconcile separately

steps.check: Run the operator on the cafe till or a desk station as shop_staff or owner
steps.expected: No pass runs (crawlerRuns needs a configured shop station); main would answer not_shop_station to any fetch and the pass would stop without reporting
steps.why: Only the shop PC may fetch the public web

steps.check: Use the shop till on branch 2
steps.expected: Only branch 2 shop products and unfinished sales show; the sale is recorded at branch 2

steps.check: Open /shop on a branch with no shop sections or products
steps.expected: Empty state "No shop products yet" / "Add the shop's products under Products. They appear here to sell." with "Open Products"

steps.check: Look at Cash and Card with an empty basket
steps.expected: Both disabled; "Scan or tap a product to start a sale." shows
steps.why: An empty sale must not be opened

steps.check: Change the shop price on Products while a sale sits in the payment pane, then settle
steps.expected: "The bill changed while you were paying. Check the new total and try again." and the pane updates to the new server total
steps.why: The customer must pay the real total

steps.check: As shop_staff with no shift open press Cash
steps.expected: The shift dialog opens first ("Start your shift to take payment"); after the shift starts the tender opens. The sale tab already exists and is listed under Unfinished sales if the dialog is closed
steps.why: Shop cash must go into a counted drawer

steps.check: As shop_staff, with someone else's shift open on the shop PC, press Cash
steps.expected: The gate asks for that shift to be closed first; a manager instead sees the note naming whose drawer the money goes into
steps.why: Money must land in the right person's drawer

steps.check: Before the day is opened, press Cash on a basket
steps.expected: open_tab refuses NO_OPEN_DAY: "No business day is open." shows under the basket and nothing is charged
steps.why: Sales outside a day break day close

steps.check: Reconnect after two offline sales
steps.expected: Queue drains; both sales appear as settled shop tabs at the server total; the shop drawer and Day close Shop block include them
steps.why: Offline sales must land exactly once

steps.check: Pull the power mid offline sale (after Cash, before settle) and reopen
steps.expected: The offline tab is restored from local storage and its queued writes replay; no duplicate sale is created on reconnect
steps.why: Power cuts must not double-charge or lose a sale

steps.check: Queue an offline sale of the last unit while another station changes that product to another branch or removes it, then reconnect
steps.expected: The replay refusal shows as a toast and is listed on Day close; the offline tab is kept with a failed mark, not silently dropped

steps.check: Have five unfinished sales
steps.expected: Three show, then "View more (2)"

steps.check: Try to Close day with an unfinished shop sale
steps.expected: Day close refuses and its Shop block says "Unfinished shop sales: N" with the hint to take the payment at the shop desk
steps.why: The day must not close with unpaid shop money

steps.check: Remove the printer from station.json (or switch it off) and complete a sale
steps.expected: The browser print dialog opens instead (fallback); the sale is already settled either way
steps.why: A missing printer must not block sales

steps.check: Point a link at a supplier page that answers 500, then one that never answers, then a 5 MB page, then a PDF
steps.expected: Products shows "Checked {time}: The supplier's site refused the page, or it no longer exists.", "...took too long to answer." (15 s), "The page is too large to read." and "The link is not a web page." respectively; the last good price stays as "Last price read: ..."
steps.why: Broken supplier links must be visible

steps.check: Save a link whose name resolves to a private address (DNS pointing at 192.168.1.1)
steps.expected: The fetch is refused before connecting and the link reads "This link cannot be read. It must be a public https page." (blocked_url)
steps.why: The shop PC must not be used to probe the venue LAN

pages.name: Shop drawer
pages.purpose: The shop PC's cash drawer: the till CashDrawer screen reused at /shop/drawer (shift, float, drawer opens, cash payments). The day close's Touch Shop block summarises the shop's money for the day.

components.name: Day close Touch Shop block
components.purpose: app.day_close_shop on /admin/day-close: shop sales by method, refunds, net, paid sale count, unfinished sales and the shop drawer shifts.

steps.check: After cash 57,500 and card 32,000 shop sales and a 7,500 refund, open Day close
steps.expected: Touch Shop block: Shop sales 89,500 IQD (Cash 57,500, Card 32,000), Refunds 7,500, Net 82,000, "Paid sales: 2"
steps.why: Day close is the money of record

steps.check: With the shop shift counted, read the Shop drawer line
steps.expected: "Counted {counted}, expected {expected}" with the IQD figures; an open shift reads "Open since {time}"

steps.check: As shop_staff open /shop/drawer on the shop PC
steps.expected: The drawer screen shows "Your shift" (since when, float, End my shift, no expected figure: blind count) and "Open drawer"
steps.why: Shop cash must be counted per shift

steps.check: Press "Open drawer" offline
steps.expected: record_drawer_open is online only: the reason prompt submits and fails with the network message; nothing is recorded
steps.why: Drawer opens are audited and need the server

steps.check: As a cafe cashier type /shop/drawer
steps.expected: Role refusal (the cafe drawer is /till/drawer)
steps.why: Each drawer belongs to its own staff

steps.check: On a day the shop never sold or opened its drawer
steps.expected: The block shows nothing

steps.check: Leave an unfinished shop sale and press Close day
steps.expected: "Unfinished shop sales: 1" with "The day cannot close while a shop sale is unpaid..." and the close is refused
steps.why: Unpaid shop money must not slip past the close

steps.check: Make day_close_shop fail
steps.expected: The block shows the error inside its own panel; the rest of Day close still works
steps.why: One failed read must not block the close screen

pages.name: Shop stock (On hand)
pages.purpose: The cafe On hand screen scoped to the shop store (StockScopeProvider scope="shop"): what is on the shop shelf per product size, with goods in and counts linking to the shop pages.

components.name: Shop on-hand list
components.purpose: Needs-you list (out of stock, running low, count needed) and the searchable table.

steps.check: Sell the last unit of a product, then open /shop/stock
steps.expected: It is listed as out of stock with "Nothing left on the shelf. Order these now: they cannot be sold until more arrive."

steps.check: Sell more units than recorded (sale offline past zero)
steps.expected: The product shows "Count needed" with "More were sold than the records showed, so these numbers are unreliable. Count them."

steps.check: Press the goods-in or count shortcut from the page
steps.expected: They open /shop/receive and /shop/counts, never /stock pages the shop assistant cannot open

steps.check: As shop_staff open /shop/stock
steps.expected: Lists shop products only (words "Product", never "ingredient"), counted in pieces with no Unit column; no cafe or bakery stock
steps.why: Shop staff must see their shelf only

steps.check: Look for Waste, stock value and costing on the shop page
steps.expected: None: the shop desk does not write stock off, and stock value/alerts are management reads

steps.check: Open /shop/stock on a branch with no shop products
steps.expected: "No shop stock yet" / "Add the shop's products under Products. Each size keeps its own stock here." with "Open Products"

steps.check: Open /shop/stock offline
steps.expected: The read fails into the error state with Retry (online read)
steps.why: Staff must know the figures are not live

pages.name: Shop goods in
pages.purpose: The cafe Goods in screen scoped to the shop: a delivery of shop products into the shop store with cost each (receive_delivery, online only).

components.name: Record a shop delivery
components.purpose: Supplier, lines of product / received / cost each (IQD), Record.

points.title: Record a shop delivery: main flow

steps.check: Record a delivery of 10 balls at 3,000 IQD each from a supplier
steps.expected: Saved; On hand rises by 10 and Products' Cost column shows 3,000 for that size
steps.why: Stock and cost drive reorder and margin

steps.check: Leave the cost of a started line empty
steps.expected: The line says what is missing and Record is held with the reason
steps.why: Half-filled lines must not be dropped silently

steps.check: Record the same delivery twice by double-clicking Record
steps.expected: Only one delivery is stored

steps.check: As manager record a shop delivery from /shop/receive
steps.expected: Allowed; it lands in the shop store, not the cafe store

steps.check: As shop_staff open /shop/receive
steps.expected: Form lists only active retail (shop) products; no receipt photo scanner and no expiry column
steps.why: Rackets and balls do not expire

steps.check: Record a delivery offline
steps.expected: receive_delivery is online only: it fails with the network message and the form keeps what was typed
steps.why: Deliveries must not be lost or half-saved

pages.name: Shop counts
pages.purpose: The cafe Count screen scoped to the shop store: start_count, blind entry, drafts autosaved locally, finalize_count corrects stock (the only way to adjust).

components.name: Shop stock count
components.purpose: Start, blind entry per product, finish with confirm, discard.

steps.check: Start a count, enter numbers for every product and finish
steps.expected: Confirm "You entered {count} products. Their stock will be corrected to your numbers. This cannot be undone."; after it On hand equals the counted numbers and Count differences opens

steps.check: During a count look for the recorded figure
steps.expected: Hidden by default (blind) behind a toggle
steps.why: Blind counts prevent copying the system figure

steps.check: Discard an open count
steps.expected: The count is dropped and stock is unchanged

steps.check: As shop_staff open /shop/counts with no count open
steps.expected: The three-step explanation and a start button; "Stock goes up with deliveries and down with sales. Nobody types a stock number..."

steps.check: Type half the counts, close the app, reopen /shop/counts
steps.expected: The draft numbers are restored from local storage for that count

steps.check: Finish a count offline
steps.expected: finalize_count is online only: it fails with the network message and the draft stays

steps.check: Start a shop count while a cafe count is open
steps.expected: The shop count covers only the shop store; the cafe count is unaffected

pages.name: Shop products
pages.purpose: One row per shop product size: SKU, barcode, cost, price, reward, on hand, supplier. Creates sections, products and sizes; shows supplier price changes with Apply new price. shop_staff and owner change launched prices directly; a manager goes through the price change protocol.

components.name: New product / size / edit

components.name: New shop section

components.name: Supplier price changes panel

components.name: Shop products (page)
components.purpose: Touch Shop catalogue, one row per size: SKU, barcode, cost, price, sales reward, on hand, supplier; New product wizard, Add size, Edit, shop sections; manager prices go to the owner via Change the price / Put on sale.

components.name: Products table

components.name: Add size / Edit size

components.name: Add shop section

points.title: New product / size / edit: main flow

steps.check: As shop_staff create "Padel ball tube", price 12,000, SKU BALL-3, barcode 6291234567890
steps.expected: Saved ("Saved."), switched on; it appears on /shop to sell and in On hand at 0 pc

steps.check: Enter a barcode or SKU already used by another product

steps.check: Save a size made in the cafe menu editor that shows "Not tracked"

points.title: Add size / Edit size: main flow

steps.check: Press Add size on a draft
steps.expected: New size form; saved with sort order after the clicked size

pages.name: Today
pages.purpose: The manager's home in Management: one "Needs you" to-do list (queues open in place), what is on the floor now, the checks before closing, stock to watch, so far today and who worked. One read (app.ops_overview) polled every 30 s and refreshed on the floor, courts and kds broadcasts. An owner who opens /ops is sent to the Overview (/panel), which shares the same "Needs you" body.

components.name: Needs you
components.purpose: The one to-do list: each row is a count in its urgency colour, a title, a hint and one action (open a screen, Review in place, or a plain note).

components.name: Online refunds needing attention (Qi Card)
components.purpose: DepositAttentionPanel mounted bare under the Needs you row: app.deposit_attention for the rail branch, worst first, with only the action the server will take for each row.

components.name: Lesson refunds due
components.purpose: LessonRefundsDuePanel bare under its row: app.lesson_refunds_due for the rail branch, with Refund (the till RefundDialog, queued) and Record the handback for a share Qi could not refund.

components.name: Player reports
components.purpose: MatchReportsPanel bare under its row: app.match_reports_open oldest first, with Close report and Ban (app.resolve_match_report).

components.name: On the floor now
components.purpose: Courts (booked, arrived, still to come, next up), Café (open tabs, orders today) and Kitchen (waiting, being made), each figure once.

components.name: Before you close
components.purpose: The two checks that stop the day closing (open tabs, this station's unsent writes), one state badge and "Go to Day close".

components.name: The day is not open
components.purpose: One banner above everything with the page's only primary button.

components.name: Stock to watch
components.purpose: Below par, expiring soon, open alerts and last stock count, each row opening exactly those items.

components.name: So far today
components.purpose: Discounts, voided items, refunds and waste with IQD and how often, opening the audit log; no-shows and cancelled bookings.

components.name: Who worked today
components.purpose: A plain table of orders, bookings and payments per person, in the server's name order; not a ranking.

components.name: Lesson refunds due panel
components.purpose: Rows Paid / Refunded so far / Due / Open lesson and the header total.

pages.name: Overview (management panel)
pages.purpose: The owner's landing screen: the wages-due reminder, "Needs you" with the owner's own rows, the live floor, then the period figures (app.panel_headline) in Earned / Taken in payments and breakdown cards, each figure drilling to its transactions, and a full export.

components.name: Earned and Taken in payments
components.purpose: Headline band in two labelled halves: Revenue (earned) and Cash + Card (taken), with comparison.

components.name: Breakdown cards
components.purpose: Padel, Cafe, Discounts refunds and waste, Online money and open matches, Lessons.

components.name: Export
components.purpose: Writes one workbook with three sheets (window, figures, transactions), reading every drill in full and bisecting any range that hits the 500-row cap.

components.name: Needs you (owner)
components.purpose: Today's Needs you body plus the owner's own rows: staff requests, new suggestions, campaigns overdue to start or end.

components.name: Wages due reminder
components.purpose: The owner's pay-day reminder card, hidden when nothing is due.

components.name: Live floor (3D) (page)
components.purpose: The venue right now as a three-dimensional plan, mounted on the owner's Overview (/panel) with links to the Bookings and Open tabs boards. Counts in React beside a lazily loaded three.js scene. Reads eight tables directly (courts, bookings, cafe tables, open tabs, staff, station assignments, heartbeats, breaks), polled 30 s and refreshed on the floor and courts broadcasts. It is not mounted anywhere else (Observe /observation redirects to /panel).

components.name: Counts and key
components.purpose: Courts in play, Tables occupied, Staff at a station, On break, the legend, and the honesty note for what the plan cannot draw.

components.name: The 3D plan
components.purpose: Lazy three.js scene: click to move closer, zoom column (Closer, track, Further), Show whole floor, full screen, wheel over the canvas only.

components.name: Tooltips and dessert case
components.purpose: Hover tooltips for courts, tables, rooms (staff) and the bar's dessert case.

pages.name: Reports layout: branch scope, period, filters, tables, drill, export
pages.purpose: The shared frame of every report: the owner-only branch scope above the page, the period picker counted from the business day, the labelled filters, the report tables, the drill-through window and the spreadsheet export. Manager and owner only.

components.name: Branch scope control (owner)
components.purpose: Lets the owner widen report/analytics RPCs to "All branches" or a closed branch's history; everything else on the page stays on the rail branch.

components.name: Period picker (DateRangeControl) and business day
components.purpose: One date-range field with presets (Today, Yesterday, This week, Last week, This month, Last month, Last 30 days), a calendar, Clear and Apply; the default is this month counted from the business day.

components.name: Labelled filters (Court, Category, Staff member, Paid by, Group by, Compare with)
components.purpose: Each report offers only the filters its RPC honours, each with a visible label; the first option is the "All …" choice.

components.name: Report table, View more cap and column notes
components.purpose: One breakdown at a time ("Show" switch with a one-line lead), a sortable table (numbers sort biggest first), three rows then "View more (n)" unless the rows are a fixed axis, and "Reading the table" notes.

components.name: Drill-through window (DrillDialog)
components.purpose: Opens the transactions behind a figure or row from report_drill: a total card, kind tabs, place filter, search, a Day column grouped by venue day, and a footer total.

components.name: Export button (spreadsheet)
components.purpose: The header "Export" button downloads the report table as a styled .xlsx workbook named <report>_<from>_<to>[_<filter>-<value>…]; there is no CSV and no print action.

components.name: Loading, error, timeout and offline states
components.purpose: Every report uses AsyncStateWrapper: a skeleton while loading, an error with Retry, an empty-period state offering a longer period; reads refetch every 120 s and are never persisted.

components.purpose: The month's server totals: Salaries, Deductions, Lateness, Bonuses (when sent), Net, Advances and Still to pay (when advances exist), Paid.

components.purpose: One row per person for the shown month: person, salary, pay day, deductions, lateness, bonuses, net, status and actions.

components.purpose: Opened row: approved deductions, late and early days, rewards reached and advances given (with Undo).

components.purpose: app.set_staff_wage: salary 0 to 100,000,000 IQD, pay day 1 to 31, starting the next pay day or an explicit month (this to three ahead).

components.purpose: app.mark_wage_paid: shows salary - deductions - lateness + bonuses = net, advances, amount to pay now, rewards, Paid from, and records the payment (p_expected_net_iqd, p_expected_paid_iqd, idempotency key).

components.purpose: app.undo_wage_paid with a required reason (1 to 1000); reopens the month and voids its safe entry.

components.name: Give advance wizard
components.purpose: app.give_wage_advance: amount 1 to what is still owed (max 100,000,000), Paid from Safe or Bank, optional note (300), review with 'Still owed after'.

components.name: Take back advance dialog
components.purpose: app.undo_wage_advance with a required reason while the month is open; voids the safe entry.

steps.check: Open Starting.

steps.check: Save a valid salary.

steps.check: Open Set salary for someone with a rate.

steps.check: Press Give advance (wages.row.advance.<id>) on a person owed 775,000.

steps.check: Give a person a 100,000 IQD advance, then view their Due now row.

steps.check: Press Mark paid on a Due now row (wages.due.pay.<staff>.<month>).

steps.check: Press Approve (wages.approve.<id>) and confirm.

steps.check: Give one advance in the month.

steps.check: View a person with salary 750,000, deductions 50,000, lateness 25,000, bonuses 100,000.

steps.check: Open details for a person with 2 approved deductions and 1 late day.

steps.check: Open details for a person with a 50,000 IQD bonus, a prize-only reward and a shop sales reward.

steps.check: With one person whose pay day was 3 days ago and one due today, view Due now (wages.due).
steps.expected: Both rows show name, month, 'Pay day <date>', '3 days overdue' in red / 'due today' in amber, and the amount still owed; earliest pay day first.

steps.check: Set the reminder to 5 days and view the lead text.

steps.check: Open the management panel as owner with 2 wages due.

steps.check: View a month with no advances.

steps.check: Press Undo payment on a paid row and press the red Undo payment with an empty reason.

steps.check: As owner, let a pay day enter the reminder window (change the reminder days up).

points.title: Wages: Who can and cannot use it

steps.check: Sign in as a manager and open /wages by typing the route.
steps.expected: Refusal card naming owner; no wages_month call returns data (server also refuses FORBIDDEN); no salaries visible.
steps.why: Salaries of colleagues must never reach a manager.

steps.check: As a manager, open the Pay section in the rail.
steps.expected: Pay tabs show Bills and suppliers, Deductions and Coach pay that the manager may open; Wages and Rewards tabs are not offered (or open the refusal), and no wagesDue badge is computed (manageWages is owner-only).
steps.why: Manager rail must not hint at salary data.

steps.check: Sign in as marketing, waiter and head_chef in turn and open /wages.
steps.expected: Refusal card each time; nothing about wages is shown.

steps.check: Let the session expire with the page open, then press Mark paid on a row and confirm.
steps.expected: The RPC is refused (not signed in / FORBIDDEN); dialog shows the error; after signing in again the month is still unpaid and no safe entry was created.
steps.why: An expired session must not half-record a payment.

steps.check: As manager, inspect the rail badges.
steps.expected: No wagesDue count is requested or shown.

steps.check: Quit the app, go offline, reopen and open /wages.
steps.expected: Table area shows the error state with Retry (wages reads are not persisted); no figures from a previous session are shown.
steps.why: Paying from stale figures offline must be impossible.

steps.check: Go offline, change the value and press Save.
steps.expected: Error text under the control (connection problem); value not saved; after reconnecting Save works.

steps.check: Go offline and press Save salary.
steps.expected: Error text in the dialog; dialog stays open with the values; nothing saved; after reconnecting Save works once.

steps.check: Go offline and confirm undo.
steps.expected: Connection error in the dialog; payment still stands after reconnect.

steps.check: Go offline and press Give.
steps.expected: Connection error in the wizard notice; nothing recorded; safe unchanged after reconnect.

points.title: Wages: Flaky or slow network, backend down

steps.check: With /wages open and loaded, go offline.
steps.expected: Already loaded figures stay visible (in-memory cache); background refetch failures do not blank the table.
steps.why: Owner can still read while connection blips.

steps.check: Make wages_due fail and open the panel.
steps.expected: No card rendered and no error shown on the panel (quiet on error).

steps.check: Block wages_month and reload.

steps.check: Press Escape while the save is pending.
steps.expected: Dialog cannot be dismissed while pending (dismissible false); Cancel is disabled.

points.title: Wages: Deductions and lateness exceed salary plus bonuses

points.title: Wages: Pay month already marked paid (frozen)

steps.check: Check the actions on a paid row.

steps.check: With nothing due, open the panel.
steps.expected: No card rendered.

steps.check: Leave the page open while a second owner session on another PC approves a deduction for someone on it.

steps.expected: Second owner sees the SUBMISSION_DECIDED message in the dialog; the list refreshes; the deduction counts once.

steps.check: Keep the dialog open while another PC approves a deduction for the same month, then press Mark paid.

steps.check: Two owners open Mark paid for the same month; first confirms, second then confirms.

steps.check: Resize to about 1024 px width.
steps.expected: Row action buttons wrap within their cell (max 22rem), table scrolls inside its own container if needed, header buttons wrap.

steps.check: With 8 wages due, view the strip.
steps.expected: Shows 3 rows then View more; View more shows all 8.

steps.check: With 60 active staff, view the table.
steps.expected: 3 rows then View more; View more shows all 60 without jank; Totals cover all 60.

steps.check: At 23:59 and 00:01 Baghdad on a pay day (and around the business-day start hour) refresh Due now.

steps.check: Pick Pay day 31.

pages.name: Pay deductions
pages.purpose: Managers propose pay deductions; only the owner approves, declines or cancels them (never their own proposal). Tabs Waiting, Month and All.

components.name: Propose / deduct form
components.purpose: Inline form for app.propose_deduction: person from deduction_targets, amount 1 to 2,000,000 IQD, date within the last 60 business days, reason up to 500.

components.name: Waiting tab
components.purpose: Waiting proposals (deductions_page filter waiting, 50 per page); owner sees Approve/Decline, the proposer Withdraw, others 'Waiting for the owner'.

components.name: Approve / decline dialog
components.purpose: app.decide_deduction with an optional note (max 1000), shared with /wages.

components.name: Withdraw proposal confirm
components.purpose: app.withdraw_deduction from the proposer's own waiting row.

components.name: All tab
components.purpose: Every deduction with status, decision, cancellation and the owner's Cancel deduction on approved unpaid ones.

components.name: Month tab
components.purpose: app.deductions_month: approved total per person for a month, waiting in the current month, expand to items, Cancel for the owner until the wage is paid.

components.name: Cancel deduction dialog
components.purpose: app.cancel_deduction with a required reason (max 1000), owner only, refused once the pay month is paid.

components.name: Deductions to decide row (/ops, Observe)
components.purpose: usePeopleRecordCounts: the waiting deductions count on Today and Observe, owner only.

pages.name: Rewards

components.purpose: app.end_staff_reward after a confirm; this month still counts.

pages.name: Files
pages.purpose: Owner and managers keep documents per branch; every file is compressed in the browser (gzip or WebP) before upload, its text is extracted for the owner assistant; owner can mark files owner-only.

components.name: Add files (drop area)
components.purpose: Drop or pick files; each is checked, compressed, begun (venue_file_begin), uploaded to the minted paths and finished (venue_file_finish), one at a time with a status line.

components.name: Text extraction for the assistant
components.purpose: extract.ts and zip.ts: text from txt/csv/html, docx/xlsx/pptx/ODF, and PDF text layer (pdf.js, first 400 pages, 500,000 characters max), gzipped beside the file.

components.name: Saved files list
components.purpose: Newest first: icon by kind, name, note, owner-only badge, added date and uploader, size before and after packing, assistant readability, actions.

components.name: Download
components.purpose: Downloads the stored object and unpacks it (gunzip to the original bytes, or the WebP).

components.name: Edit in place
components.purpose: app.venue_file_update: name (1 to 200), note (max 500), owner-only toggle for the owner.

components.name: Remove file
components.purpose: Confirm, then storage objects removed first, then venue_file_delete (row needed by the storage delete rule).

pages.name: Goods in
pages.purpose: Book deliveries into stock: an invoice-shaped typed delivery (app.receive_delivery), the driver purchases (app.receive_purchase), scanned supplier receipts (app.confirm_receipt) and costing what staff logged on the phone (app.price_logged_stock). Online-only.

components.name: Delivery table lines
components.purpose: Per line: item, received, ordered, cost per base unit, expiry, line total, remove.

components.name: Line totals and delivery total
components.purpose: Each line value = round(received × cost); delivery total = sum of line values; shown beside Record to tick against the paper.

components.name: Supplier, store and notes
components.purpose: Supplier combobox, Put it in store picker (cafe/bakery), notes.

components.name: Store being counted hold
components.purpose: A manager count open at the chosen store holds Record (STORE_BEING_COUNTED).

components.name: Record delivery
components.purpose: Books one delivery via app.receive_delivery with an idempotency key.

components.name: Goods in vs Main cash (safe)
components.purpose: Booking goods never pays anyone: supplier and shopping payments are logged separately on Safe > Pay (main_cash_pay, paid from safe or bank).

components.name: Waiting work chips
components.purpose: One row of chips (Scanned receipts, Bought by the driver, Added by staff) that opens each list in place.

components.name: Added by staff (set cost)
components.purpose: Phone-logged deliveries (app.log_stock) booked at an estimate; manager sets the real cost via app.price_logged_stock.

components.name: Bought by the driver list
components.purpose: Purchases from the driver phone still to receive (app.purchases_to_receive), oldest first.

components.name: Receive one driver purchase
components.purpose: The driver lines with Received and Expiry per line, store picker, supplier, Receive into stock (app.receive_purchase); non-stock and switched-off lines are marked checked (app.acknowledge_purchase_line).

components.name: Scan receipt button
components.purpose: Uploads a receipt photo, files app.create_receipt, opens its review and asks receipt-scan to read it.

components.name: Scanned receipts list
components.purpose: Receipts still to check (app.receipts_to_review), with status, read total and Check.

components.name: Receipt review (?receipt=)

components.name: Composer
components.purpose: The question box: Enter sends, Shift+Enter new line, Stop while streaming, max 4000 characters, locked until a scope is picked.

components.purpose: One live turn per question: deltas, tool rows, gate, usage and job events; refusals map to one sentence each.

components.purpose: Re-reads the tools an answer used against live data and lists figures that changed; no AI call, nothing billed.

components.purpose: Follow-up questions under the newest clean answer (Compare that with last week, Break it down by item, …).

components.purpose: When a question needs more rows than one turn, shows This needs a job with rows, chunks, tokens and price, and Answer from aggregates / Run live / Run as batch / Not now.

components.purpose: Watches an accepted job: status, chunks done, tokens so far and price, Cancel job.

components.name: Cost toolbar and monthly cap bar
components.purpose: The open chat toolbar shows Chat $x · Month $y; its panel shows Today, This month and This chat tiles, the Monthly cap bar and Usage and limits →.
