pages.name: Install (Windows and macOS)
pages.purpose: Getting the operator desktop app onto the till, desk, kitchen screen and shop PCs: the PowerShell route, the browser download, the per-user NSIS installer and the gated macOS build.

components.name: PowerShell install command
components.purpose: irm https://<guest-site>/install-operator.ps1 | iex: reads latest.yml, downloads the versioned installer, checks sha512, installs silently per user and opens the app.

components.name: Browser download and SmartScreen
components.purpose: The stable link releases/latest/download/Touch-Padel-Operator-Setup.exe, and what Windows shows while builds are unsigned.

components.name: NSIS per-user installer
components.purpose: oneClick:false, forced per-user (installer.nsh isForceCurrentInstall), shortcuts, runAfterFinish.

components.name: macOS build
components.purpose: dmg and zip for arm64 and x64, hardened runtime, notarized, gated on four Apple secrets.

components.name: Launch on boot
components.purpose: app.setLoginItemSettings({openAtLogin:true}) on every packaged start.

components.name: Startup failure handling
components.purpose: reportFatalStartup: a boot throw becomes a dialog, a startup-error.log line and an exit.

steps.check: On a clean Windows 10 or 11 PC, open Windows PowerShell and paste the install command
steps.expected: It prints "Checking the latest version...", "Downloading Touch Padel Operator X.Y.Z (N MB)...", "Checking the download...", "Download verified.", "Installing...", then "Done. Touch Padel Operator X.Y.Z is installed. Opening it now..." and the app opens
steps.why: This is the primary install route for every station

steps.check: Watch for an administrator prompt during the PowerShell install
steps.expected: No UAC prompt appears; the app lands under %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Touch Padel Operator
steps.why: A per-user install is what lets a start install updates without anyone approving a prompt

steps.check: Set TP_INSTALL_DRY_RUN=1 and TP_INSTALL_TAMPER_TEST=1, then run the command
steps.expected: It prints "TAMPER TEST: appending one byte to the download.", then "The download does not match the release feed (sha512 mismatch), so it was deleted and nothing was installed." and stops; the temp file is gone and nothing is installed
steps.why: A tampered or truncated installer must never run on a till

steps.check: Run with TP_INSTALL_DRY_RUN=1 only
steps.expected: It prints "DRY RUN: would run: ... /S /currentuser" and "DRY RUN OK: Touch Padel Operator X.Y.Z downloaded and verified." and installs nothing
steps.why: Lets support test a PC without touching it

steps.check: Set "Choose where to get apps" to Recommendations (warn me), then run the command
steps.expected: A yellow heads-up "Windows may ask once about installing an app from outside the Store. Click "Install anyway"." and the install continues
steps.why: Otherwise staff cancel the Windows prompt

steps.check: Run the command a second time on an installed and configured station
steps.expected: The installer replaces the app in place; the app opens to sign-in as the same station (no setup screen), queue.db intact
steps.why: Reinstalling must never re-identify or empty a till

points.title: Browser download and SmartScreen: main flow

steps.check: Click the Windows download button on /download
steps.expected: Touch-Padel-Operator-Setup.exe downloads from github.com/KaguSoftware/touchpadel-releases/releases/latest/download and is the newest published version
steps.why: The stable link is printed in the runbook and must never go stale

steps.check: After the first signed release, run Get-AuthenticodeSignature on the downloaded Setup.exe
steps.expected: Status is Valid and SignerCertificate names the publisher; only then flip SHOW_SMARTSCREEN_NOTE to false, and only once a fresh browser download shows no warning
steps.why: Removing the warning early strands staff at a prompt

steps.check: Install from the same Setup.exe on a 32-bit Windows 10
steps.expected: The installer picks the ia32 build by itself and the app starts
steps.why: The installer carries both builds (nsis x64 + ia32)

steps.check: Install on Windows 10 on ARM
steps.expected: The 32-bit build installs and runs
steps.why: Documented as covered by the ia32 build

steps.check: Double-click Setup.exe
steps.expected: No "just me / everyone" page and no administrator prompt; the folder page allows a change; the last page starts the app
steps.why: Per-user is forced so updates can install at start

steps.check: Look for shortcuts after install
steps.expected: A desktop shortcut and a Start menu entry named Touch Padel Operator exist

steps.check: Run Setup.exe from an administrator account
steps.expected: It still installs for the current user only (HKCU InstallLocation, not HKLM)
steps.why: An all-users install blocks start-time updates

steps.check: Uninstall from Settings > Apps
steps.expected: The app is removed; %APPDATA%/touch-padel-operator/queue.db and station.json remain on disk
steps.why: Unsent sales and the station identity must survive an uninstall

steps.check: Reinstall after the uninstall
steps.expected: The app opens straight to sign-in as the same station; Day close still lists any rows that were waiting

steps.check: On the till, finish setup and watch for the Windows Firewall prompt
steps.expected: Windows asks once to allow the app on private networks (port 47810); allowing it lets the kitchen screen connect
steps.why: Without it the LAN kitchen fallback is dead

steps.check: Check the release assets of the newest operator release
steps.expected: If the macOS job ran: Touch-Padel-Operator-arm64.dmg, -x64.dmg, both zips, their blockmaps and latest-mac.yml are present

steps.check: Open the arm64 dmg on an Apple silicon Mac and launch the app
steps.expected: It opens without an unidentified-developer block (signed and notarized)
steps.why: Gatekeeper would otherwise stop the install

steps.check: Open the x64 dmg on an Intel Mac
steps.expected: The app launches and better-sqlite3 loads (no startup error dialog)
steps.why: before-pack fetches the right native module per arch

steps.check: Force a boot failure (for example a better-sqlite3 built for the wrong ABI on a test machine) and launch
steps.expected: A dialog titled "Touch Padel Operator could not start" shows the error and "Saved to <userData>/startup-error.log"; the app exits
steps.why: operator-v0.2.0 sat with no window and ate every later click

steps.check: After that failure, click the shortcut again
steps.expected: A new instance starts (the single-instance lock was released by the exit)
steps.why: Staff must be able to retry

steps.check: Build locally without VITE_SUPABASE_URL and VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY and launch
steps.expected: The renderer refuses to start instead of silently pointing at localhost
steps.why: A venue build talking to 127.0.0.1 would queue every sale forever

steps.check: Check the sidebar version line on every venue machine
steps.expected: It shows a tagged X.Y.Z, never a dev build pointed at a localhost guest site
steps.why: apps/operator/.env on a dev machine points at localhost

steps.check: Open https://<guest-site>/download on a laptop
steps.expected: The page shows the PowerShell command with a copy button and the Windows download button as the fallback
steps.why: Staff cannot install a station without it

steps.check: Install on each of the three venue machines (till, desk, kitchen screen) and the shop PC, then record station id and the sidebar version line in the venue sheet
steps.expected: Every machine shows the same "Version X.Y.Z" line and a distinct station id
steps.why: Mismatched versions or duplicate ids break replay and the audit trail

steps.check: Restart a configured packaged station
steps.expected: The app starts by itself at Windows login, kiosked, with no Task Scheduler entry
steps.why: A till must come back after a power cut with nobody touching it

steps.check: Run an unpackaged dev build
steps.expected: No login item is registered
steps.why: Dev machines must not auto-launch a till

points.title: Install (Windows and macOS): Unsigned build on Windows

steps.check: Watch for a SmartScreen prompt on the PowerShell route with an unsigned release
steps.expected: No SmartScreen prompt: a PowerShell download carries no Mark of the Web
steps.why: The documented way around SmartScreen until releases are signed

steps.check: Run the downloaded installer while releases are unsigned
steps.expected: "Windows protected your PC" appears; More info then Run anyway installs the app
steps.why: Staff must know this is expected until signing lands

steps.check: Download the installer in Edge while unsigned
steps.expected: Edge warns the file is not commonly downloaded; ... then Keep then Keep anyway keeps it and it runs

steps.check: Set Windows "Choose where to get apps" to Microsoft Store only, then run the command
steps.expected: Red text "Windows is set to install apps from the Microsoft Store only, which blocks this installer." with the Windows 10 and Windows 11 settings paths; nothing is installed
steps.why: Staff need to know what to change instead of a silent failure

steps.check: With the SmartScreen policy ConfigureAppInstallControl set to StoreOnly by IT policy, run the command
steps.expected: Red text "This PC only allows apps from the Microsoft Store, and an administrator or IT policy sets that." and nothing is installed
steps.why: Policy-managed PCs need an administrator, not a retry

steps.check: On a PC with an existing all-users install, run the command
steps.expected: Red text "An all-users copy of Touch Padel Operator is already installed on this PC." plus the uninstall steps and "Your till data is kept (queue.db and station.json in %APPDATA%)."; nothing is installed
steps.why: Two copies side by side would fight over queue.db

steps.check: Run the command while the operator app is open with queued rows (WAN unplugged on the till first, then reconnect only the laptop doing the download)
steps.expected: Yellow "The operator app is running: it will close and reopen during the install."; after the install the app reopens on the new version and the queued count is unchanged
steps.why: An install must never lose unsent sales

steps.check: Cut power to the till mid-service, restore it
steps.expected: Windows boots, the app auto-launches, and the queued count matches what it was before the cut

steps.check: Run the command on a PC with no internet
steps.expected: The script stops with an error message in red; nothing is installed and no half-installed app remains
steps.why: A failed install must leave the machine as it was

steps.check: Run the command on Windows in S mode
steps.expected: PowerShell is blocked by Windows; the runbook path (Switch out of S mode) is the only fix

steps.check: On 32-bit Windows, run an installer older than operator-v0.2.21
steps.expected: "This app can't run on your PC"; downloading again from the stable link fixes it

steps.check: Deny the firewall prompt on the till, then pull the WAN
steps.expected: The kitchen screen cannot reach the till; its LAN board stays on "Offline - waiting for tickets from the cafe cashier over the local network."
steps.why: Shows the cost of a denied firewall rule during the drill

steps.check: Run an older Setup.exe over a newer installed version
steps.expected: It replaces the app in place; station.json and queue.db are kept

steps.check: With the Apple secrets absent, push a tag
steps.expected: The macos job is skipped, publish still runs, and no mac assets are attached
steps.why: Windows releases must not wait on Apple credentials

pages.name: Operator release tag flow and code signing
pages.purpose: Cutting an operator release: the CI gate, version stamping, Windows signing (Azure, eSigner or PFX), the gated macOS build and publishing to KaguSoftware/touchpadel-releases, which is also the auto-update feed.

components.name: CI gate on the tagged commit
components.purpose: Waits for a successful ci.yml run on the tagged sha before building anything.

components.name: Prepare: version, credentials, draft
components.purpose: Parses the version from the tag, decides the signing route and creates the draft release.

components.name: Windows build, signing and proof
components.purpose: Stamps the version, builds renderer and shell, rebuilds better-sqlite3 for Electron, signs if credentials exist, publishes, and proves the signature.

components.name: macOS build and notarization
components.purpose: Developer ID imported to a temp keychain, dmg and zip for arm64 and x64, notarized and published.

components.name: Publish to the public releases repo
components.purpose: Asserts every asset is attached, then turns the draft into the latest release.

components.name: Version visible on stations
components.purpose: The tag version appears on the sidebar version line, the setup screen and device_heartbeats.app_version.

points.title: Prepare: version, credentials, draft: main flow

steps.check: Push the tag operator-v0.3 (not semver)
steps.expected: prepare fails "operator-v0.3 is not operator-v<semver> (e.g. operator-v0.2.0)"
steps.why: The version stamps the installer and the update feed

steps.check: Push a prerelease tag operator-vX.Y.Z-beta.1
steps.expected: It is accepted and published as an ordinary release; a station on it still takes X.Y.Z at its next start
steps.why: updater isAtOrAbove sorts a prerelease below its release

steps.check: Read the prepare log
steps.expected: A notice "windows signing: <azure|esigner|pfx|unsigned> - macOS build: <true|false>" names the route taken
steps.why: Tells you whether this release is signed before stations take it

steps.check: Re-run the workflow for a version whose draft already exists
steps.expected: The log says "release vX.Y.Z already exists - reusing it"
steps.why: Re-runs must not create duplicate releases

points.title: Windows build, signing and proof: main flow

steps.check: After a release, check main for changes to apps/operator-shell/package.json
steps.expected: No commit: the version is stamped only inside the job
steps.why: The tag is the only version source

steps.check: Read the "Rebuild better-sqlite3 for Electron (and prove it loads)" step
steps.expected: It passes; a wrong ABI fails the job before anything is published
steps.why: v0.2.0 shipped a module built for Node and never started

steps.check: On a signed release, read "Prove the Windows build is signed"
steps.expected: Touch-Padel-Operator-Setup.exe, win-unpacked and win-ia32-unpacked Touch Padel Operator.exe each print Valid by <subject>; any NotSigned or HashMismatch fails the job
steps.why: An unsigned exe would be refused by the updater

steps.check: On a signed release with WIN_SIGN_PUBLISHER_NAME, open win-unpacked/resources/app-update.yml from the artifact
steps.expected: It contains publisherName
steps.why: From then on every station refuses an update that is not signed by that name

steps.check: Take the eSigner route with a CodeSignTool zip whose sha256 does not match
steps.expected: The step fails "CodeSignTool zip sha256 mismatch"
steps.why: The signing tool itself must not be tampered with

steps.check: Open the run's artifacts
steps.expected: operator-windows-X.Y.Z holds the exe, the yml files and the blockmap, kept 14 days
steps.why: Lets you inspect exactly what shipped

points.title: Publish to the public releases repo: main flow
components: Publish to the public releases repo

steps.component: Publish to the public releases repo
steps.check: Read the publish job of a successful run
steps.expected: It lists the assets and finds Touch-Padel-Operator-Setup.exe, its .blockmap and latest.yml (and the mac set when built)
steps.why: A release without latest.yml breaks every station's update check

steps.component: Publish to the public releases repo
steps.check: Delete one asset from the draft and re-run publish
steps.expected: It fails "<file> is missing from release vX.Y.Z - not publishing" and the release stays draft
steps.why: Half a release must not become latest

steps.component: Publish to the public releases repo
steps.check: After publish, open the stable link releases/latest/download/Touch-Padel-Operator-Setup.exe
steps.expected: It downloads the new version
steps.why: Fresh installs take the newest build

steps.component: Publish to the public releases repo
steps.check: Download latest.yml and the exe; compare sha512
steps.expected: The base64 sha512 in latest.yml matches the exe (the PowerShell script checks exactly this)
steps.why: A mismatch blocks every scripted install

points.title: Operator release tag flow and code signing: other parts
components: CI gate on the tagged commit

steps.check: Push tag operator-vX.Y.Z on a commit that is on main
steps.expected: The operator-release run starts with jobs gate, prepare, windows, macos (or skipped) and publish

steps.component: CI gate on the tagged commit
steps.check: Tag a commit whose ci.yml run is green
steps.expected: The gate logs "CI is green on <sha8>." and prepare starts

steps.component: CI gate on the tagged commit
steps.check: Tag a commit while its CI is still running
steps.expected: The gate polls every 30 s (up to 90 times) and continues once CI goes green, or fails "gave up waiting for CI"
steps.why: Tag right after push is the normal flow

steps.check: With all four Apple secrets set, push a tag
steps.expected: The macos job imports the identity ("security find-identity" lists it), builds, notarizes and publishes dmg and zip per arch

steps.check: After an update, read the sidebar version line
steps.expected: It reads "Version X.Y.Z" matching the tag
steps.why: How staff confirm a station took the update

steps.check: Open Settings > Devices as the owner after the update

steps.why: The owner checks every station from one screen

points.title: Operator release tag flow and code signing: ge
components: CI gate on the tagged commit
Publish to the public releases repo

steps.component: CI gate on the tagged commit
steps.check: Tag a commit whose ci.yml run failed
steps.expected: The gate fails with "No green CI ... Tag a commit CI passed." and nothing is built or published
steps.why: A red commit must never reach the tills

steps.check: Remove OPERATOR_SUPABASE_URL (in a fork or test repo) and push a tag
steps.expected: prepare fails "OPERATOR_SUPABASE_URL / OPERATOR_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY are missing"; nothing is published
steps.why: A build without them crashes at startup on every till

steps.check: Push a tag with RELEASES_GH_TOKEN missing
steps.expected: prepare fails "RELEASES_GH_TOKEN is missing"

steps.why: Stations that know a publisher name refuse unsigned updates

steps.check: Take the unsigned route (no credentials, no publisher name)

steps.why: Expected until the owner's certificate lands

steps.check: With one Apple secret missing, push a tag
steps.expected: macos is skipped and publish still flips the release to latest

steps.check: Try to re-publish an already used version number from a different commit
steps.expected: Do not: a station that ran that version will never install it at a start; publish a higher version instead
steps.why: Runbook rule: never reuse a version number

steps.check: Boot a station right after an update while offline
steps.expected: It does not paint data restored from the previous version's cache shape (PERSIST_BUSTER changes with the version); screens load from ref_cache or show their loading state
steps.why: Old cache shapes can crash new screens

pages.name: First run station setup
pages.route: Station setup screen (shown when station.json is missing)

pages.name: Durable offline queue
pages.purpose: The SQLite write queue every registered mutation goes through in Electron, online or offline: fsynced before the renderer is told, encrypted at rest, ordered by seq, never deleted.

components.name: Enqueue
components.purpose: Validates the envelope, encrypts the payload, inserts with WAL + synchronous FULL, kicks the worker and feeds the LAN server.

components.name: Row states
components.purpose: pending, inflight, acked, conflict, failed, resolved; rows are never deleted.

components.name: queue.db schema upgrades
components.purpose: PRAGMA user_version 1..6 migrations run on open; old rows keep replaying.

components.name: Unreadable queued payload
components.purpose: A row whose ciphertext cannot be decrypted is parked as failed and stays visible.

components.name: Crash and power-cut recovery
components.purpose: An inflight row found on boot is re-sent first; the idempotency key makes the re-send safe.

pages.name: Sync worker and replay
pages.purpose: Drains the queue strictly by seq, one row at a time, as the staff session the renderer pushed; maps every answer to ack, conflict, failed, retry or pause.

components.name: Strict order and exactly-once
components.purpose: One row at a time by seq; a duplicate key returns the stored result.

components.name: Answer map: retryable vs terminal
components.purpose: 200 ack, 200 duplicate of conflict = conflict, 409 conflict, other 4xx failed, 429/5xx/network/timeout retry, 401 pause.

components.name: Replay authentication
components.purpose: The renderer pushes the staff token over touch:auth-state; 401 pauses replay until a different token arrives.

components.name: Branch scope on replay
components.purpose: Each row carries the branch in scope when queued (v6); replay sends it as venue_scope.

pages.name: Renderer write results and offline tabs
pages.purpose: How a screen learns what happened to its write: an 8 s wait for the server echo, the queued state after that, toasts for later refusals, per-row pending marks, and tabs that exist only on this till.

components.name: 8-second wait then queued
components.purpose: mutate() resolves with the server echo inside 8 s, or {queued:true} after it; a refusal inside the wait throws beside the control.

components.name: Did-not-sync toasts
components.purpose: QueueFailureToasts names the write (Order, Payment, Booking, Refund...) and the reason code.

components.name: Offline tabs on the floor plan
components.purpose: A tab opened offline lives in localStorage (touch-operator-offline-tabs) under local:<key> until its tab.open acks; a settled one stays until its settle acks.

components.name: Per-row pending marks
components.purpose: usePendingResults keeps a row marked until its localId returns acked, conflict or failed.

pages.name: LAN kitchen screen link
pages.route: ws://<till LAN IP>:47810 (till server, kitchen screen client, /kds LAN board)
pages.purpose: Keeps tickets reaching the kitchen when the cloud path is down: the till serves kitchen-bound orders over the LAN behind the pairing code, and kitchen bumps ride back onto the till's own queue.

components.name: Till LAN server
components.purpose: Binds the first RFC1918 IPv4 on port 47810, checks the bearer PSK in constant time, sends a snapshot on auth.

components.name: Ticket ring buffer
components.purpose: Every order.create / order.add_items enqueued on the till is pushed into a 500-entry in-memory ring and broadcast.

components.name: Kitchen screen LAN client
components.purpose: Connects to till_host with the PSK, forwards frames to the board, reconnects forever (2 s doubling to 30 s).

components.name: LAN board fallback
components.purpose: When the cloud tickets query errors, KdsBoard renders the LAN tickets; names come from the kitchen screen's own cached menu.

components.name: Kitchen bumps over the LAN
components.purpose: A LAN bump becomes a ticket.status envelope on the TILL's queue (till station key, till's signed-in staff), echoed to every kitchen screen.

pages.name: Auto-update and Quit reopens
pages.route: Rail "Update ready" row, kitchen pill, Quit to desktop, start-time install (updater.ts)

components.name: Check and silent download

components.name: Install at the next start
components.purpose: A start that finds a newer download installs before the window opens (wait up to 15 s Windows, 30 s macOS), once per version.

components.name: Rollback

pages.name: Window security and IPC
pages.route: Main window webContents guards, preload window.touch bridge, ipc-validate.ts
pages.purpose: Pins the window to the bundled renderer, sends links to the system browser, blocks webviews, recovers from crashes, and validates every IPC message before it touches the queue, cache, printer or LAN.

components.name: Navigation lock
components.purpose: will-navigate and will-redirect allow only file: (and the dev server origin in dev).

components.name: External links and webviews
components.purpose: window.open goes to the system browser for https only; webview attach is blocked.

components.name: Renderer crash recovery
components.purpose: render-process-gone reloads; a React throw shows the crash screen.

components.name: IPC validation
components.purpose: Every channel validates its argument; a malformed one is refused with "invalid IPC payload: ..." and logged.

components.name: Preload bridge surface
components.purpose: contextIsolation, sandbox, no nodeIntegration; window.touch exposes only named calls.

pages.name: App shell and boot

pages.name: Query layer, retries and offline rules

points.title: Query layer, retries and offline rules: other parts

steps.check: Make a new booking attempt after a refusal

steps.why: Key reuse across intents would replay the wrong answer

points.title: Query layer, retries and offline rules: With no internet

steps.check: Tap Cancel booking with airplane mode on
steps.expected: The cancel fails now with the network line (cancel_reservation is never retried automatically) and the booking stays as it was
steps.why: An automatic cancel retry once returned NOT_CANCELLABLE for a cancelled booking

steps.check: Join a match / book a lesson / register for a tournament offline
steps.expected: These run now or fail now: an error shows immediately; nothing is queued to fire later
steps.why: A join landing minutes later on a changed match is wrong

steps.expected: Match, coaching, tournament and ranks data are NOT restored from disk (never persisted): they show loading or error; Bookings and the Book grid do restore
steps.why: Live state shown from an old disk copy would mislead guests

points.title: Query layer, retries and offline rules: ge

steps.check: Trigger a business refusal (e.g. tap a slot someone else just took: SLOT_TAKEN)
steps.expected: The refusal shows at once (no retry delay) and never reads as 'No connection'
steps.why: Retrying a decision wastes seconds and mislabelled errors confuse guests

steps.check: Kill connectivity mid-request on a read (e.g. pull to refresh Bookings)
steps.expected: The query pauses and resumes on reconnect; it does not fail with an error screen if cached data exists

steps.check: Tap Reserve court on Review with airplane mode on, then turn it off within the hold
steps.expected: The confirm (keyed, confirm_booking) waits and goes through once on reconnect; exactly one booking is created
steps.why: A paused booking that doubles or vanishes is a money and trust problem

steps.check: Leave a request hanging (server slow) for more than the request deadline
steps.expected: The request times out (TimeoutError) and is treated as a transport failure: the network line and a retry, not a frozen spinner; edge functions get 30 s
steps.why: Requests with no deadline hung forever before

steps.check: Retry a failed hold after a transport error
steps.expected: The retry carries the same idempotency key ({station}:{mutation}:{ulid}); the server creates one hold, not two
steps.why: Double holds block other guests and hit the hold quota

steps.why: Schema drift must not lock guests out of booking

components.purpose: The GL court (Court3D/CourtStage) and the court-to-sheet transition with the PICK A TIME pill.

components.name: Branch picker
components.purpose: Chooses which branch's courts and grid are shown (guestVenue).

components.name: Day chips and duration
components.purpose: Trading-night day chips (09:00 to the small hours of the next date) and the duration choice.

components.name: Slot grid
components.purpose: Merged availability across courts: free (price), booked, held, blocked, desk-only (horizon) cells, capacity counts, realtime updates.

components.name: Tap a free slot (hold)
components.purpose: Signed out goes to Welcome with the slot pending; the booking gate goes to complete-profile or phone verification; otherwise hold_slot with an idempotency key, then Review.

components.name: Open-match chips
components.purpose: When the branch has open matches on, chips beside the grid show matches at a time; tapping a free time may offer Book / Start an open match / Join.

steps.check: Open the Book tab and tap Check availability
steps.expected: The court animates into the booking sheet; the PICK A TIME pill and round back button appear; tapping back returns to the court

steps.check: On a phone where GL is unavailable (some emulators)
steps.expected: The GL-less branch shows the Check availability button and the footer 'Reserve in the app · pay at the desk on arrival'; booking still works
steps.why: No GL must not block booking

steps.check: Leave the app on the Book tab for 10 minutes (screen on)
steps.expected: Battery and heat stay reasonable; the render cap holds; no memory growth crash
steps.why: The court is a GL surface on the most visited tab

points.title: Tap a free slot (hold): main flow

steps.check: Signed in with a verified phone, tap a free slot
steps.expected: hold_slot runs; Review opens with the countdown, court, date, time, duration and price

steps.expected: HOLD_QUOTA_EXCEEDED; My reservations shows the held cards where each can be finished or released

steps.expected: One hold; the second tap replays the same hold (duplicate) and Review opens once

steps.expected: Review shows the kind hold warning (review.hold-warning)
steps.why: Guests who let holds lapse are warned

steps.check: Wrong gender for the hour (women-only hours) tap a slot
steps.expected: The server refuses with its gender line; nothing is held

steps.expected: The grid recomputes which starts can fit; prices update to the new duration

steps.expected: Each shows its price in IQD (formatPrice, thousands grouped, no decimals) or booking.callOnly when there is no rate; capacity 'N free' when several courts are free

steps.expected: They match exactly (peak/off-peak, 60/90/120)
steps.why: Price shown must equal price charged

steps.check: Inspect the Book tab with the Maestro / Appium inspector
steps.expected: Interactive elements carry the agreed testIDs, including book.view-availability, book.back-to-court, book.branch, book.sheet, book.sheet.day.<date>, book.sheet.duration, book.sheet.slot.<court>.<time>, book.account, book.court-title
steps.why: Automated regression tests depend on stable testIDs

steps.check: Tap each day chip
steps.expected: The grid shows that trading night; the selected chip is highlighted

steps.check: Look at booked, held and blocked slots

points.title: Book tab: Flaky or slow network, backend down

steps.check: Open the Book tab on a throttled connection (Network Link Conditioner / Android emulator 'Edge', or 3G with packet loss) and use its main action
steps.expected: The grid shows a loading state then fills; a hold tap on a flaky link either succeeds once or shows the network line; retrying reuses the same idempotency key so at most one hold exists
steps.why: Iraqi mobile data is often slow; a hung or doubled write loses trust or money

steps.check: Load the grid with the server failing
steps.expected: An error with Retry (book.sheet.retry), not an endless spinner

steps.check: Tap a slot, lose connection before the answer, reconnect
steps.expected: The keyed retry runs once; one hold exists; Review opens
steps.why: Lost answers must not create two holds

steps.check: Match chips query fails
steps.expected: The grid still works (chips fail fast and are omitted)

points.title: Book tab: Venue trading offline (degraded mode)

steps.expected: degraded.bannerAvailability shows; free cells read as desk-only; tapping one does not hold

pages.name: Review and confirm
pages.purpose: Navy hold card with live countdown, summary, pay-at-desk card, cancellation policy, and Reserve court (native confirm alert) or Pay now by Qi Card depending on the venue deposit mode. Terminal states for hold expired and slot taken.

components.name: Hold card and countdown
components.purpose: Countdown and progress bar from the hold's expiry.

components.name: Summary and policy
components.purpose: Court name (by language), date, time, duration, price, pay-at-desk card and cancellation policy line.

components.name: Reserve court
components.purpose: Native confirmation alert, then confirm_booking (keyed by hold id).

components.name: Pay now by Qi Card
components.purpose: Deposit mode optional or required: deposit_quote decides the footer; deposit-begin then the payment screen and Qi's page.

components.name: Hold expired / slot taken
components.purpose: Full-screen terminal states with Back to availability.

points.title: Hold card and countdown: main flow

steps.expected: booking.heldForYou with a m:ss countdown that ticks every second and a shrinking bar; booking.holdExplainer text

steps.expected: Review opens with no countdown (no deadline) rather than an instant expired screen
steps.why: Past bug: duplicate replay read as expired

steps.check: Background the app for 3 minutes and return
steps.expected: The countdown reflects real elapsed time

steps.check: Tap Reserve court and cancel the alert

steps.check: Build with EXPO_PUBLIC_ONLINE_PAYMENTS off

steps.check: Earn points at the till, then pull to refresh
steps.expected: The balance increases by the server's amount; 'worth' shows the IQD value

steps.check: Read the minimum redeem line
steps.expected: 'Use points at the cashier from {points}'

steps.check: Read an item reward (0350)
steps.expected: The reward names the exact item and size; its cost in points; the note says use it at the till
steps.why: Item rewards free one unit of that exact size

steps.check: Read an IQD-off reward
steps.expected: The IQD amount off is shown correctly formatted

steps.check: Redeem an item reward at the till, then check history
steps.expected: A redeem row with the points; the balance drops by the cost

steps.check: Look at history rows
steps.expected: Each row shows its kind's line, points (+/-) and date in Baghdad time

steps.check: Inspect Points and rewards with the Maestro / Appium inspector
steps.expected: Interactive elements carry the agreed testIDs, including loyalty.show-card, loyalty.balance, loyalty.tier, loyalty.tier-progress, loyalty.reward.<id>, loyalty.history.<id>, loyalty.history-empty, loyalty.off, loyalty.error
steps.why: Automated regression tests depend on stable testIDs

steps.check: Tier progress
steps.expected: Current tier, points needed for the next within the window, or top tier

steps.check: Open Points and rewards with Wi-Fi and mobile data off (airplane mode)
steps.expected: Cached loyalty data shows if persisted, else an error with Retry; Show card still opens the offline card
steps.why: A guest at the club with weak signal must not see a broken screen

steps.check: Open Points and rewards on a throttled connection (Network Link Conditioner / Android emulator 'Edge', or 3G with packet loss) and use its main action
steps.expected: Loading shows a spinner or skeleton, requests time out with a clear error rather than hanging, and a retry succeeds once the connection improves; nothing is recorded twice
steps.why: Iraqi mobile data is often slow; a hung or doubled write loses trust or money

steps.check: Switch the app to Arabic (Settings > Language) and open Points and rewards
steps.expected: Every string is Arabic (no English keys or English fallbacks), the layout mirrors (leading edge on the right), back chevrons and arrows point the Arabic way, numbers and phone numbers are not scrambled by bidi
steps.why: Most guests use Arabic; a half-translated or unmirrored screen looks broken

steps.check: Reward names in Arabic
steps.expected: Arabic reward names (rewardName by locale)

steps.check: Set Appearance to Dark and open Points and rewards
steps.expected: Background, cards, text and icons use the dark palette; no white flashes, no black text on navy, native bar chevron and title visible
steps.why: Unreadable text in dark mode blocks use at night

steps.check: Set Appearance to Light (and then Automatic with the phone in light mode) and open Points and rewards
steps.expected: Light palette throughout; status bar icons dark on light; Automatic follows the phone setting live
steps.why: Theme mismatch looks unfinished in App Review

steps.check: Open Points and rewards on a small phone (iPhone SE 3rd gen / 5-inch Android) with the keyboard open where there are fields
steps.expected: Nothing is clipped or overlapped; the primary action (Show card) is reachable by scrolling and is not hidden behind the keyboard or the tab bar
steps.why: Small phones are common among guests; a hidden button blocks the flow

steps.check: Set the OS text size to the largest (iOS Larger Text / Android Font size max) and open Points and rewards
steps.expected: Text grows without overlapping or being cut off mid-word; buttons still fit their labels; the screen still scrolls to every control
steps.why: Accessibility settings must not make the app unusable

steps.check: Turn on VoiceOver (iOS) / TalkBack (Android) and swipe through Points and rewards
steps.expected: Every control is reached in reading order and announced with a meaningful label and role; the primary action is announced as 'Show card' button
steps.why: Store review and blind or low-vision guests rely on labels

steps.check: On iOS, swipe back from the left edge (right edge in Arabic) on Points and rewards; on Android, press the system back button / back gesture
steps.expected: The screen pops to the one beneath it with the native animation; if it was opened from a link with nothing beneath, it lands on the tabs instead of doing nothing
steps.why: Back must always work; a dead end makes guests force-quit

steps.check: Let the session expire (revoke the refresh token in Supabase or sign the account out on the server) and return to Points and rewards
steps.expected: The failed token refresh signs the app out; RequireSession replaces the screen with Welcome (or an action shows the auth.sessionExpired line for AUTH_REQUIRED); no private data from the old session stays on screen
steps.why: A dead session that looks alive makes every action fail silently

steps.check: Signed out, open Points and rewards directly (link or adb/xcrun openurl)
steps.expected: RequireSession shows a spinner while auth initialises, then replaces the screen with Welcome (Sign in / Create account / Keep browsing); the private screen never renders its data
steps.why: Private data must never render without an account

steps.check: Open Points and rewards on an account with no data for it
steps.expected: loyalty.guest.home.historyEmpty and loyalty.guest.rewards.empty
steps.why: A blank screen with no explanation looks broken

steps.check: Loyalty off
steps.expected: loyalty.guest.off; nothing offered

steps.check: Unknown ledger kind from a newer server
steps.expected: The row is skipped, not crashing

steps.check: Over 50 rows
steps.expected: Only the last 50 show; scrolling is smooth

components.purpose: The owner's per-person lists on the operator Staff page: second jobs open that role's pages too, blocked pages are kept off the person's screens.

components.name: Working venue
components.purpose: Every staff call passes p_venue_id; the venue is the remembered one (per account) or the first; a picker shows only with more than one.

components.name: Staff sign-out
components.purpose: Sign out from Today: confirm, an activity "signed_out" ping (1.5 s at most), then the session ends and caches are wiped.

components.name: Show guest view
components.purpose: A staff session can look at the guest app as a guest sees it and return with one tap; memory only.

components.name: Screenshot guard
components.purpose: Blocks screenshots and recordings for every staff role except the owner and reports each screenshot heard to log_staff_screenshot with the page.

components.name: Activity ping (0341)
components.purpose: While any staff account is signed in, pings staff_activity_ping with the page: active on mount, every 60 s, on each new page, background when the app leaves the screen.

components.name: Undo instead of "Are you sure?"
components.purpose: A withdraw, cancel or untick happens on screen at once, a toast offers Undo for 5 s, and only then is the call sent; one action waits app-wide; leaving the app or the page sends what waits.

components.name: Work photos (PhotoButton, staff-media)
components.purpose: Take or choose a photo, re-encoded to JPEG with no EXIF, long edge 2048, uploaded to the staff-media bucket through staff_media_slot; used by checklists, steps, ideas, teachings, purchases, incidents, marketing, content and scans.

steps.check: Untick a line with no photo

steps.check: Kill the app, turn on airplane mode, relaunch and open Checklist

steps.expected: The button stops spinning within a few seconds and the page shows "No connection. Check your internet and try again."; the form keeps what was typed and nothing appears on the operator's checklist report after reconnecting
steps.why: A staff write runs now or fails now; a silent queue would make staff believe it landed

steps.check: Untick a photo line offline and let the toast run out
steps.expected: The line comes back ticked and shows "No connection." under it
steps.why: A failed untick must restore the row

steps.why: An empty page must say why

steps.check: Open after midnight but before the business day changes (Asia/Baghdad)
steps.expected: "Business day" shows the business day the server uses, and the lists are that day's
steps.why: Night shifts tick yesterday's lists otherwise

steps.check: Switch the app to Arabic in Settings and open Checklist
steps.expected: The page lays out right to left (back chevron, lists, icons mirrored), every label is Arabic with no English key or fallback left, each line's tick box on the right, and numbers and IQD amounts read correctly
steps.why: Most staff read Arabic; an English or mirrored-wrong page slows the floor

steps.check: Revoke the session (owner resets the password on the operator Staff page, or wait past token expiry with the app in the background), then come back to Checklist and pull to refresh
steps.expected: The page does not show stale data as current: the read fails with an error or the app returns to sign-in; no write goes through under the old session
steps.why: A leaver must not keep working on a dead session

steps.check: Have a colleague with the same role tick a shared line on their phone, then pull

steps.check: Both phones tick the same shared line at the same moment
steps.expected: One tick stands; neither phone shows an error beyond a refresh
steps.why: Races on a shared list must not error

steps.check: With a lossy connection (Network Link Conditioner, 100% loss for 3 s then normal), tick a checklist line
steps.expected: The action ends in one state on the operator's checklist report; a repeat answers as already done and nothing is doubled
steps.why: A dropped answer must never double a record

steps.check: Let tick a checklist line fail offline, turn the connection back on and press the same button again without changing anything
steps.expected: It succeeds on the second press and only one record exists on the operator's checklist report
steps.why: Retrying after a failure must not create a duplicate

steps.check: Take the photo, then lose the connection before the tick lands

steps.check: Tick a line while the list is being closed (the owner ends it on the operator)

steps.check: Kill the app after the photo uploaded but before the tick answered, then reopen
steps.expected: The line is either ticked (the call landed) or unticked with no photo; never ticked without its photo
steps.why: A tick must carry its proof

steps.check: Untick a line that has a photo
steps.expected: It unticks at once with a toast "Unticked. Its photo goes with it." and Undo for 5 s
steps.why: Unticking deletes the proof, so it gets Undo

steps.check: Press Undo on that toast
steps.expected: The line is ticked again with its photo; the server never saw the untick

components.name: On my way

components.name: Done

pages.name: Site platform: layout, locale routing, CSP and security headers
pages.purpose: The document shell every page renders in (html lang/dir, fonts, theme tokens) and the request envelope proxy.ts puts on every response: locale redirect, per-request CSP nonce, static security headers.

components.name: Content-Security-Policy with per-request nonce
components.purpose: proxy.ts builds a fresh CSP with a nonce on every request and Next stamps it on its inline scripts.

components.name: Static security headers
components.purpose: next.config.ts serves STATIC_SECURITY_HEADERS on every path and the table header set on table and menu paths.

components.name: Root layout and metadata defaults
components.purpose: Sets lang, dir, theme tokens, font preloads, viewport and the site-wide metadata defaults (title template, icons, OG).

components.name: PostHog analytics (café menu)
components.purpose: Lazy-loads posthog-js on idle when NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY is set; ?analytics=off kills it per device; the table token is redacted from captured URLs.

steps.why: A script-src that allows inline or eval makes any XSS fatal

pages.name: Table QR exchange
pages.purpose: The printed table QR URL. proxy.ts swaps the token for an HttpOnly tp-table cookie and 307s to the token-less /{locale}/menu; the route handler repeats this if the proxy is bypassed; /{locale}/t is the old session URL, now a 307 to the menu.

components.name: Table session boot
components.purpose: useTableSession signs in anonymously, calls app.open_table_session(token) and tracks states none, binding, bound, invalid, expired, error.

steps.check: Scan a real printed table QR (https://www.touch-padel.com/t/<token>) with an Arabic phone
steps.expected: One 307 to /ar/menu; the address bar shows /ar/menu with no token; DevTools Application > Cookies shows tp-table=<token>, HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite=Lax, Path=/, expires in 12 h
steps.why: The token is a bearer credential for the table tab; it must leave the URL

steps.check: Scan the same QR on an English phone with no tp-locale cookie
steps.expected: Lands on /en/menu (Accept-Language negotiation)

steps.check: Open /en/t/<token>?analytics=off
steps.expected: Lands on /en/menu?analytics=off (query preserved, token removed)

steps.check: curl -sI https://www.touch-padel.com/t/<token>
steps.expected: 307 with Location /<locale>/menu, Set-Cookie tp-table, Cache-Control no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate, private, Referrer-Policy no-referrer, and the CSP header
steps.why: The one request with the token in its URL must never be cached or referred

steps.check: Request /en/t/tok.x (dotted last segment the proxy matcher skips)
steps.expected: The route handler still performs the exchange: 307 to /en/menu with the tp-table cookie and no-store/no-referrer; never renders the menu with a token in the URL
steps.why: Defence in depth when the proxy is bypassed

steps.check: Open /ar/t and /t (no token)
steps.expected: 307 to /ar/menu and /<negotiated>/menu, with CSP and no-store on the hop; not a permanent 308
steps.why: Old bookmarks still work and the move can be undone later

steps.check: Open /ar/t/ (trailing slash)
steps.expected: Lands on /ar/menu (no trailing slash)
steps.why: Trailing slash must not produce a 404

steps.check: On the menu after a scan, open DevTools Network, browse and order, and inspect every outbound request (PostHog, images, Supabase)

pages.name: Touch Cafe menu
pages.purpose: The cafe menu for walk-ins and table guests. Walk-ins browse and build a basket; a table-bound guest (tp-table cookie) sends orders to the waiter, calls the waiter and follows order status live. Payment is at the desk.

components.name: Top bar
components.purpose: Table chip, cafe wordmark, locale switcher and basket button (count + total).

components.name: Cafe hero
components.purpose: Brand hero, a featured item card (with badge, discount, from-price and marquee), or a media hero, chosen by cafe settings.

components.name: Category pills
components.purpose: Sticky horizontal rail; tapping scrolls to the section; scroll-spy highlights the current one and centres it.

components.name: Menu sections and cards
components.purpose: Each category is a section with a big word band and illustration; each item card shows thumb, name, hook, temperature chips, price, discount and sold-out stamp.

components.name: Menu unavailable state
components.purpose: Shown when the menu status is error or empty, with a Retry that refreshes and reconciles the basket.

components.name: Item sheet
components.purpose: Bottom sheet with photo layers, sticky name, hook, description, allergens, size picker, modifier groups (with revealed sub-groups), suggestions, item note, quantity and Add to order.

components.name: Basket sheet
components.purpose: Lists lines with quantity steppers and remove, the order note, subtotal, featured discount and total, the degraded notice, the pay-at-desk note and Send to waiter.

components.name: Send to waiter (app.create_guest_order)
components.purpose: Submits the basket with an idempotency key (salt + basket fingerprint); handles ok, duplicate, expired, degraded, stale and error results.

components.name: QR required sheet
components.purpose: Explains that ordering or calling the waiter needs the table QR; keeps the basket.

components.name: Call waiter (bell)
components.purpose: Floating bell; sheet with reasons (order, bill, water, assistance); app.raise_waiter_call; phases sending, raised, acknowledged, done; 120 s cooldown stored per table.

components.name: Bell tutorial spotlight
components.purpose: First time a bound guest lands with the bell enabled, a spotlight points at the bell for 6 s, once per browser session.

components.name: Orders strip and orders sheet
components.purpose: Live orders strip under the pills and a sheet listing live and earlier orders with a three-step tracker, status, time, total and lines; updated by the session:{id} realtime channel with a 30 s poll fallback.

components.name: Earn points chip (loyalty)
components.purpose: For a bound table: signed-out shows Sign in to earn points (to /account?return=...), signed-in links the guest session to the member (app.link_guest_session) and shows the balance; hidden when loyalty is off.

components.name: Venue degraded mode watch
components.purpose: useVenueMode polls app.venue_mode every 30 s while visible and flips the basket and waiter sheets to their refused notices.

components.name: Live menu refresh
components.purpose: Private menu channel listens for menu_changed and settings_changed broadcasts (filtered by branch) and refetches with debounce and jitter; refetches on online and when the tab returns after 60 s.

components.name: Cafe footer
components.purpose: Strapline, venue name, week hours with today highlighted, phone, pay-at-desk, and links to the site, support, privacy and terms; hides the bell while visible.

components.name: Toasts and scroll-to-top
components.purpose: Polite toast pill (info 1.7 s, error 4 s) and a scroll-to-top button after 320 px.

pages.name: Edge function platform (shared plumbing)
pages.purpose: The 26 Supabase edge functions and their shared modules: verify_jwt pinning, body caps, timeouts, error mapping and secrets. Used by every app; owned by the developer and checked on hosted before launch.

components.name: requireStaffRole guard
components.purpose: Resolves the caller from the JWT and checks an active staff row with an allowed role.

components.name: Service-role-only entry points
components.purpose: Cron-driven functions accept only the service-role JWT (isServiceRoleRequest).

components.name: Body caps and outbound timeouts
components.purpose: readJsonBody byte caps and fetchWithTimeout on every outbound call.

points.title: Edge function platform (shared plumbing): main checks

steps.check: Run supabase functions list --project-ref lczijabnorujcgmbuqlw from packages/db
steps.expected: Exactly the 26 functions of fixtures/verify-jwt.json are deployed: analytics-insights, analytics-posthog, apple-revoke, assistant-chat, assistant-component, assistant-free, assistant-index, assistant-job, deposit-begin, deposit-reconcile, deposit-status, deposit-webhook, desk-customer-create, lesson-begin, payments-fake, protocol-action, receipt-scan, release-review, replay, send-push, send-sms-otp, staff-admin, telegram-callback, telegram-diagnose, telegram-send, ticket-begin
steps.why: A function missing on hosted is a dead button in an app

steps.check: Run node scripts/check-verify-jwt.mjs --deployed from packages/db (the deploy.yml step 4)
steps.expected: Exits 0: every hosted function has the verify_jwt of the fixture; only deposit-webhook, payments-fake, send-sms-otp and telegram-callback are false
steps.why: A flipped verify_jwt opens a function to unauthenticated callers

steps.check: Run pnpm --filter @touch/db check:verify-jwt locally
steps.expected: config.toml [functions.*] blocks match fixtures/verify-jwt.json for all 26 entries
steps.why: Local config drifting from the fixture hides a security change

steps.check: POST a body larger than the function cap (e.g. 300 KB to replay, 70 KB to deposit-webhook)
steps.expected: replay answers 413, deposit-webhook 413, send-sms-otp refuses before parsing; no row is written
steps.why: Unbounded bodies are a denial-of-service and cost vector

steps.check: Make a function call fail inside Postgres (e.g. a P0001 refusal) and read the HTTP body
steps.expected: Body carries only the stable error code (and detail for P0001), never raw Postgres, vendor or stack text; the raw text is in the function log only
steps.why: Raw errors leak schema and vendor details to guests

steps.check: Check the CI job "edge functions (deno check)" on the last main run

pages.name: Online payments (Qi Card): deposits, tickets, lessons
pages.route: deposit-begin, deposit-status, deposit-webhook, deposit-reconcile, ticket-begin, lesson-begin, payments-fake
pages.purpose: Server half of online money: begin a Qi payment, poll and webhook it to a final state, sweep, cancel and refund. Paused chain-wide since 0340 until Qi is live.

components.name: deposit-begin
components.purpose: Starts a Qi payment for a held booking via app.deposit_prepare, gateway create, app.deposit_mark_created.

components.name: deposit-status
components.purpose: The payment screen's poll; runs app.deposit_status as the caller and asks Qi when the attempt is open.

components.name: deposit-webhook
components.purpose: Qi's notificationUrl; verifies the RSA X-Signature first, then re-asks Qi's status API and applies through app.deposit_apply.

components.name: deposit-reconcile (sweeper)
components.purpose: Cron tp_deposit_sweep every 30 s: checks stale payments, cancels past deadline (3 tries then GIVE_UP), sends refunds.

components.name: ticket-begin (open-match tickets)
components.purpose: Guest buys 1 to 3 open-match tickets via app.ticket_payment_prepare and the shared gateway create.

components.name: lesson-begin
components.purpose: Guest pays a held lesson place online via app.lesson_payment_prepare; deposit_apply's lesson arm books the place.

components.name: payments-fake (local only)
components.purpose: Stand-in Qi page for the local stack with Succeed, Declined, Wrong code and Do nothing.

pages.name: Money RPC invariants
pages.purpose: Integer IQD everywhere, price computed server-side (payloads never carry a price), quote equals charge, PIN-gated adjustments, idempotent money writes, refunds capped at what is due.

components.name: Quote equals charge
components.purpose: The price a guest or the desk sees is the price written.

components.name: Manager PIN grants
components.purpose: apply_discount, override_price, refund, void_after_send, write_off_expired, deposit_refund_manual, match_seat_write_off, lesson_blocked_refund_record, coach statement actions need a manager PIN grant.

components.name: Idempotent money writes
components.purpose: Non-idempotent money writes take p_idempotency_key and app.claim_replay.

components.name: Refunds
components.purpose: refund is capped by what was paid and what is due; tournament tabs need tournament_goodwill to exceed refund_due.

components.name: Loyalty and discounts as money
components.purpose: loyalty_redeem needs the member token (spent once) or a PIN grant; loyalty_adjust caps a manager at 1,000 points per 24 h.

components.name: hold_slot, confirm_booking, staff_create_reservation, cancel_reservation
components.purpose: Court money: quoted price stamped on the hold, confirmed at the price the rate rule names now, one winner per slot.

components.name: open_tab, till_add_items, guest orders
components.purpose: Opening tabs and adding lines: payloads never carry a price; the server prices every line.

components.name: settle_tab, settle_zero_tab, cancel_tab, compute_tab_totals
components.purpose: Taking payment: totals recomputed on the server, TOTAL_CHANGED guard, integer change.

components.name: void_after_send, refund
components.purpose: Taking money or goods back: manager PIN grant, open day, never above what was paid.

components.name: split_evenly, split_by_item, merge_tabs
components.purpose: Splitting and merging bills.

components.name: apply_discount, override_price, customer discounts, manager PIN
components.purpose: Price reductions: manager PIN grant for till discounts and overrides; standing customer discounts with no PIN.

components.name: Online deposit rows (booking_payments, deposit_apply, deposit refunds)
components.purpose: The database side of Qi deposits, tickets and lesson payments.

components.name: open_day, close_day
components.purpose: The business day: one open day per branch, close refuses open tabs and unsynced tills.

components.name: open_till_shift, close_till_shift
components.purpose: Per-person drawer shifts: counted float in, blind count out.

components.name: main_cash_pay, move, count, void, hand_in_day
components.purpose: The safe: costs, moves, counts and day hand-ins by manager and owner.

components.name: mark_wage_paid, give_wage_advance, undo_wage_advance, deductions
components.purpose: Owner-only pay: net = salary - deductions - penalties + bonuses; paid = net - advances.

components.name: coach_statement_mark_paid, coach_statement_void
components.purpose: Coach statements paid outside the till with a manager PIN that is not the coach's own.

components.name: loyalty_redeem, loyalty_adjust
components.purpose: Points and item rewards: proof by member token or manager PIN, spent once.

components.name: Touch Shop sales and sale rewards
components.purpose: Shop tabs settle like cafe tabs but count as padel revenue; the seller earns a frozen percent.

components.name: claim_replay and the idempotency contract
components.purpose: Every non-idempotent money write takes p_idempotency_key and app.claim_replay.

pages.name: Scheduled jobs (pg_cron)
pages.purpose: Every sweep, reminder, purge and nightly the system relies on. Schedules are best-effort DO blocks, so they must be asserted on hosted after every push.

components.name: Booking and hold jobs
components.purpose: tp_hold_sweep, tp_hold_strikes, tp_match_sweep (30 s), tp_lesson_sweep, tp_tournament_sweep.

components.name: Reminders and staff nudges
components.purpose: Booking reminders (outbox scheduled_for start - 3 h), checklist_sweep, protocol_remind_sweep (3 h then daily, 09:00 to 23:00 branch time).

components.name: Money jobs
components.purpose: tp_deposit_sweep, tp_reward_sweep, tp_shop_reward_sweep, tp_coach_statements, tp_loyalty_nightly, tp_price_promo_apply, tp_expiry_flagging.

components.name: Assistant and housekeeping jobs
components.purpose: tp_assistant_cache_fill (01:20, no-op while off), prunes and purges.

components.name: Job inventory on hosted
components.purpose: All 28 schedules exist on hosted with the expected cadence and succeed.

components.name: tp_hold_sweep (* * * * * (every minute))
components.purpose: Expires holds past their TTL and orphan holds; skips a hold whose online payment is open until 10 minutes after its deadline; no longer settles strikes (0268). Runs select app.expire_stale_holds(); scheduled in 0021, body 0291.

components.name: tp_degraded_sweep (* * * * *)
components.purpose: Opens or ends each open branch's degraded_periods row to match app.is_degraded. Runs select app.sweep_degraded_periods(); scheduled in 0021, body 0229.

components.name: tp_expiry_flagging (0 2 * * * (02:00 UTC = 05:00 Baghdad))
components.purpose: One open manager alert per stock batch entering its branch's expiry window. Runs select app.flag_expired_batches(); scheduled in 0021, per-venue window 0214.

components.name: tp_telegram_sweep (10 seconds (falls back to every minute if the seconds syntax is unsupported))
components.purpose: Nudges the telegram send function to drain telegram_outbox. Runs select app.telegram_nudge(); scheduled in 0032.

components.name: tp_telegram_prune (30 3 * * * (03:30 UTC))
components.purpose: Retention for the Telegram outbox and tap ledger. Runs inline delete: telegram_outbox sent older than 30 days, telegram_actions older than 90 days; scheduled in 0032.

components.name: tp_push_sweep (30 seconds (fallback every minute))
components.purpose: Posts to send-push when notification_outbox has due unclaimed rows (attempts < 5, claim older than 60 s). Runs select app.push_nudge(); scheduled in 0090.

components.name: tp_assistant_job_tick (* * * * *)
components.purpose: Asks assistant-job to poll the vendor batch while a batch job runs. Runs select app.assistant_job_tick_nudge(); scheduled in 0113.

components.name: tp_assistant_index_sweep (* * * * *)
components.purpose: Drains assistant_index_queue through the assistant-index function. Runs select app.assistant_index_nudge(); scheduled in 0110.

components.name: tp_assistant_index_prune (45 3 * * *)
components.purpose: Retention for the index queue. Runs inline delete of assistant_index_queue rows claimed more than 7 days ago; scheduled in 0110.

components.name: tp_assistant_prewarm (30 * * * * (hourly at :30))
components.purpose: Posts prewarm to assistant-component only when the venue local hour is 3; skips cards not viewed in 7 days. Runs select app.assistant_prewarm_nudge(); scheduled in 0141, 0207.

components.name: tp_protocol_tick (*/5 * * * *)
components.purpose: Asks protocol-action to launch due releases and purge photos (stopped runs after 90 days, incidents past purge_after, unclaimed photos after a day, scanned papers, coach photos, avatars). Runs select app.protocol_tick_nudge(); scheduled in 0173, body 0302.

components.name: tp_release_review (20 4 * * * (04:20 UTC))
components.purpose: Asks release-review to write the day-30 reviews that are due. Runs select app.release_review_nudge(); scheduled in 0173.

components.name: tp_hiring_purge (40 3 * * *)
components.purpose: Deletes hiring candidates past purge_after and overwrites run notes with [deleted after 90 days]. Runs select app.hiring_purge_due(); scheduled in 0176.

components.name: tp_price_promo_apply (*/5 * * * *)
components.purpose: Applies scheduled price/promo runs whose date has come, each in its own block; a failure reopens the apply step and tells the managers. Runs select app.price_promo_apply_due(); scheduled in 0177.

components.name: tp_incident_purge (50 3 * * *)
components.purpose: Blanks incident text past purge_after (365 days) and keeps kind, place and times. Runs select app.incident_purge_due(); scheduled in 0198.

components.name: tp_deposit_sweep (30 seconds (fallback every minute))
components.purpose: Posts to deposit-reconcile when booking_payments has created, pending or refund_pending rows not claimed in 60 s. Runs select app.deposit_nudge(); scheduled in 0242.

components.name: tp_scan_sweep (* * * * *)
components.purpose: Ends receipt and slip readings older than 3 minutes with READ_ABANDONED. Runs select app.scan_sweep_stale(); scheduled in 0240.

components.name: tp_match_sweep (30 seconds (fallback every minute))
components.purpose: Per due match (max 200 a run, each in its own block): closes expired requests, drops deleted or banned holders, cancels matches that no longer fit, books waiting matches. Runs select app.match_sweep(); scheduled in 0263.

components.name: tp_hold_strikes (* * * * *)
components.purpose: Settles lapsed mobile holds and lesson strikes into the hold ladder, oldest first. Runs select app.hold_strikes_settle(null); scheduled in 0268, body 0295.

components.name: tp_lesson_sweep (* * * * *)
components.purpose: Expires held enrolments, cancels deleted accounts' enrolments, retires a retired coach's lessons, judges group and course cut-offs (max 200 items, coach try-locks). Runs select app.lesson_sweep(); scheduled in 0286, body 0295.

components.name: tp_coach_statements (0 12 1 * * (12:00 UTC on the 1st))
components.purpose: Drafts each (coach, branch) statement for the previous local month with a COMMIT per pair. Runs call app.coach_statements_draft(null); scheduled in 0287, rescheduled 0293.

components.name: tp_tournament_sweep (* * * * *)
components.purpose: Closes or cancels at registration cut-off, withdraws deleted accounts, finishes tournaments 6 h past ends_at. Runs select app.tournament_sweep(); scheduled in 0300, body 0310.

components.name: tp_loyalty_nightly (15 0 * * * (00:15 UTC = 03:15 Baghdad))
components.purpose: Recomputes loyalty caches per profile with a COMMIT every batch, expires points for inactivity while loyalty is on, stops at the budget. Runs call app.loyalty_nightly_run(); scheduled in 0306, procedure 0309.

components.name: tp_checklist_sweep (*/5 * * * *)
components.purpose: Materialises today's occurrences, queues checklist_due 30 min before and checklist_overdue after, never to people on approved leave. Runs select app.checklist_sweep(); scheduled in 0323.

components.name: tp_reward_sweep (*/5 * * * *)
components.purpose: Unlock pushes when an order target is reached; earnings for ended business months (max 12 back) under app.lock_wage. Runs select app.reward_sweep(); scheduled in 0333.

components.name: tp_assistant_cache_fill (20 1 * * * (01:20 UTC))
components.purpose: While the cache is enabled, stores closed days older than freeze_days; stores nothing while off (ships OFF). Runs select app.assistant_cache_fill(62); scheduled in 0330.

components.name: tp_shop_reward_sweep (*/5 * * * *)
components.purpose: Writes shop_sale_reward_earnings for ended months, idempotent by (branch, person, month). Runs select app.shop_reward_sweep(); scheduled in 0355.

components.name: tp_protocol_remind (*/15 * * * *)
components.purpose: decision_waiting to deciders 3 h after a submission then every 24 h, only 09:00 to 23:00 branch time. Runs select app.protocol_remind_sweep(); scheduled in 0363.

pages.name: pnpm security and its sub-checks
pages.purpose: The stackless security gate CI runs on every push: env names, history secrets, dependency audit with dated waivers, data hygiene, web hardening, quiet errors, no config push, Electron lock, RPC registry, assistant coverage, error codes, config env, verify_jwt.

components.name: security:env-names
components.purpose: Nothing secret behind NEXT_PUBLIC_, EXPO_PUBLIC_ or VITE_.

components.name: security:history
components.purpose: Fails if a secret-bearing file was ever committed.

components.name: security:audit with dated waivers
components.purpose: Dependency audit gated on new vulnerabilities; backlog in .security/audit-waivers.json with UTC expiries.

components.name: security:data
components.purpose: No real email, national-ID-shaped number or dialable Iraqi mobile in fixtures, seeds or intake packs.

components.name: security:web and the production-header e2e
components.purpose: CSP with a per-request nonce, HSTS, frame-ancestors locked.

components.name: quiet-errors, config-push, electron, config-env, verify-jwt, registry, coverage, error-codes
components.purpose: The remaining sub-checks.

components.name: security:env-names
components.purpose: Fails any NEXT_PUBLIC_/EXPO_PUBLIC_ name matching SECRET|KEY|TOKEN|PIN|HMAC unless allowlisted by exact name.

components.name: security:history
components.purpose: Walks every added path in full history for secret-bearing files; content-checks .pem and .npmrc.

components.name: security:audit
components.purpose: pnpm audit high+ against .security/audit-waivers.json; un-waived or expired fails, stale is reported.

components.name: security:data
components.purpose: Fails on real-format Iraqi mobiles, real emails or national-ID-shaped numbers in fixtures, seeds and intake packs; test range +964 7XX 000000NN.

components.name: security:web
components.purpose: Locks CSP nonce, headers in next.config.ts, the table-token cookie exchange and the no-service-worker PWA rule.

components.name: security:quiet-errors
components.purpose: SEC-36: no raw error text (e.message) reaches a guest surface in apps/mobile or apps/web.

components.name: security:config-push
components.purpose: Nothing in the repo may run supabase config push; no allowlist.

components.name: check:electron (operator-shell)
components.purpose: Locks sandbox, contextIsolation, navigation guards, window-open denial in the Electron main.

components.name: check:rpc-registry (db)
components.purpose: Every client-callable RPC is classified; RLS-matrix coverage only goes up.

components.name: check:assistant-coverage (db)
components.purpose: Every table, view, function, route, edge function, cron job and doc has a declared path to the assistant or a reason it is excluded.

components.name: check:error-codes (db)
components.purpose: Every raise exception code is in ERROR_CODE_KEYS with lines in both catalogs; the unmapped list only shrinks.

components.name: check:config-env (db)
components.purpose: Every [auth.sms.test_otp] value in config.toml is env(NAME), never a literal.

components.name: check:verify-jwt (db)
components.purpose: config.toml verify_jwt equals fixtures/verify-jwt.json for every function; deploy step 4 runs --deployed against hosted.

components.name: check-artifact-secrets (web, desktop, mobile)
components.purpose: Not in pnpm security: runs inside the CI jobs that build each artifact.

pages.name: Operator desktop release (operator-release.yml)
pages.purpose: A tag builds Windows (x64 + ia32) and optionally macOS installers with hosted env baked in, signs if credentials exist, publishes to KaguSoftware/touchpadel-releases; stations auto-update.

components.name: Release jobs
components.purpose: gate, prepare, windows, macos, publish.

components.name: Job: CI is green on the tagged commit
components.purpose: Polls CI runs for the tagged sha every 30 s up to 90 times.

components.name: Job: prepare
components.purpose: Version from tag, credential inventory, draft release creation in the public repo.

components.name: Job: windows
components.purpose: Stamps version, builds renderer with hosted env, bundles main/preload, rebuilds better-sqlite3 for Electron, builds NSIS x64+ia32, signs when a route exists, publishes into the draft.

components.name: Job: macos
components.purpose: Runs only when MAC_CSC_LINK, APPLE_ID, APPLE_APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD and APPLE_TEAM_ID exist; own keychain import; dmg + zip for arm64 and x64; notarize via scripts/notarize-mac.cjs.

components.name: Job: publish
components.purpose: Asserts every asset exists, then flips the draft to the latest release.

components.name: Version-less download URLs and the update feed
components.purpose: releases/latest/download/<fixed name> never changes; latest.yml and latest-mac.yml are the electron-updater feed.

components.name: Install and update on every station; Devices panel
components.purpose: Per-user NSIS install, check at start, 30 s retry, every 6 h; install at start or on Update ready / Quit to desktop; device_heartbeats.app_version shown in Settings > Devices.

components.name: Rollback to a previous tag
components.purpose: Install an older Setup.exe from the releases page; stop a bad release by publishing a higher version or taking it down.

pages.name: Environment variables and secrets per environment
pages.route: local / CI / hosted Supabase / Vercel / EAS / GitHub
pages.purpose: One table of where each secret lives; service-role key only in packages/db/.env and GitHub Environment secrets.

components.name: SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN
components.purpose: Personal Supabase access token used by deploy, drift and db-ops to link the hosted project.

components.name: PROJECT_REF
components.purpose: Bare hosted project ref (lczijabnorujcgmbuqlw).

components.name: SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD
components.purpose: Hosted Postgres password for db push, migration list, db dump.

components.name: SUPABASE_AUTH_SMS_TEST_OTP_CODE
components.purpose: Repository VARIABLE substituted into config.toml [auth.sms.test_otp] at supabase start in CI db, e2e and bench.

components.name: OPERATOR_SUPABASE_URL
components.purpose: Hosted Supabase URL baked into the operator renderer as VITE_SUPABASE_URL.

components.name: OPERATOR_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
components.purpose: Hosted anon key baked into the operator renderer as VITE_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY.

components.name: OPERATOR_GUEST_SITE_URL
components.purpose: Guest site origin baked in as VITE_GUEST_SITE_URL (QR cards, links).

components.name: RELEASES_GH_TOKEN
components.purpose: Fine-grained PAT, contents:write on KaguSoftware/touchpadel-releases only; publishes the operator.

components.name: MAC_CSC_LINK
components.purpose: Base64 Developer ID .p12 for the mac build (with MAC_CSC_KEY_PASSWORD).

components.name: APPLE_ID
components.purpose: Apple ID + APPLE_APP_SPECIFIC_PASSWORD + APPLE_TEAM_ID for notarization (GitHub).

components.name: WIN_ESIGNER_USERNAME
components.purpose: SSL.com eSigner route (with WIN_ESIGNER_PASSWORD, _CREDENTIAL_ID, _TOTP_SECRET); chosen route, not yet configured.

components.name: WIN_SIGN_PUBLISHER_NAME
components.purpose: Repository VARIABLE: certificate CN(s) written into app-update.yml; set only together with a signing route.

components.name: TELEGRAM_BOT_TOKEN
components.purpose: telegram-send / telegram-callback bot token.

components.name: TELEGRAM_WEBHOOK_SECRET
components.purpose: Must equal the secret_token passed to setWebhook.

components.name: GROQ_API_KEY
components.purpose: analytics-insights and the free assistant model (GROQ_MODEL openai/gpt-oss-120b, GROQ_JUDGE_MODEL).

components.name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
components.purpose: assistant-chat when the default model is claude-* (ANTHROPIC_MODEL).

components.name: POSTHOG_PERSONAL_API_KEY
components.purpose: analytics-posthog with POSTHOG_PROJECT_ID (209766) and POSTHOG_HOST eu.

components.name: SEND_SMS_HOOK_SECRET
components.purpose: Standard-Webhooks secret GoTrue signs the Send SMS hook with (v1,whsec_...). Hosted value from Auth > Hooks.

components.name: SMS_PROVIDER
components.purpose: log | twilio | otpiq | whatsapp; launch is otpiq with OTPIQ_API_KEY, OTPIQ_PROVIDER whatsapp-sms, OTPIQ_SENDER_ID empty until approved.

components.name: OTPIQ_API_KEY
components.purpose: OTPIQ credentials for WhatsApp-first codes.

components.name: APPLE_PRIVATE_KEY_P8
components.purpose: apple-revoke with APPLE_TEAM_ID, APPLE_KEY_ID, APPLE_CLIENT_ID com.kagu.touchpadel.

components.name: PAYMENTS_PROVIDER
components.purpose: Online deposits: unset = nothing charged; qi needs QI_BASE_URL, QI_TERMINAL_ID, QI_USERNAME, QI_PASSWORD, QI_WEBHOOK_PUBLIC_KEY_PEM; fake is refused off the local stack.

components.name: QI_SANDBOX_TERMINAL_ID
components.purpose: Qi sandbox terminal (with QI_SANDBOX_USERNAME, _PASSWORD, _WEBHOOK_PUBLIC_KEY_PEM) used only for payment_sandbox profiles (store review).

components.name: PAYMENTS_SITE_URL
components.purpose: Where Qi returns the browser: {origin}/{locale}/pay/return. Default https://www.touch-padel.com.

components.name: RECEIPT_READER
components.purpose: receipt-scan reader; fake only on local/CI; real reader through _shared/receipts/connect.ts with RECEIPT_API_KEY and RECEIPT_MODEL.

components.name: EMBEDDING_PROVIDER
components.purpose: Assistant embeddings: local (owner call) or voyage/openai with their key.

components.name: Vault secrets (table_token_secret, service_role_key, functions_base_url)
components.purpose: Database-side secrets read by pg_net cron calls and the QR table token HMAC.

components.name: Vercel: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL / _ANON_KEY (or _PUBLISHABLE_KEY) / _SITE_URL
components.purpose: Public values inlined at build time into the web bundle.

components.name: Vercel: APPLE_TEAM_ID and ANDROID_SHA256_FINGERPRINTS
components.purpose: Server-only values used by the force-static .well-known routes.

components.name: Vercel: NEXT_PUBLIC_POSTHOG_KEY/HOST, NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_STORE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_PLAY_STORE_URL, NEXT_PUBLIC_WEB_OAUTH
components.purpose: Optional switches that change what the site shows.

components.name: EAS env and credentials
components.purpose: eas.json profile env (public), GOOGLE_SERVICES_JSON file env, EXPO_UPDATE_PRIVATE_KEY, FCM V1 service account key, Apple distribution credentials and APNs key.

pages.name: Monitoring and alerting

components.name: Crash reporting

components.name: Alerting and who gets paged
components.purpose: Red workflow emails go to the actor; nightly drift and bench are the only scheduled alarms; manager_alerts and Telegram are venue-side.

components.name: Uptime checks
components.purpose: No uptime monitor is configured in the repo.

components.name: Job and queue health

pages.name: Go-live data steps (need Majed's explicit go)
pages.purpose: Backup, hosted wipe of user data (dry run, stop, execute), pre-system padel reports, assistant cache init. Each step is irreversible or production-affecting and runs only on Majed's word.

components.name: 1. Fresh backup
components.purpose: pg_dump of hosted before anything.

components.name: 2. Wipe user data
components.purpose: scripts/wipe-user-data.mjs: dry run by default, refuses unlisted tables, keeps staff and coach logins and --keep-email.

steps.expected: Operator and RPCs open the desk; edge functions using requireStaffRole read only staff.role, so desk-customer-create is expected to refuse (403): record as a defect if so

steps.check: Block the Till area for a cashier and call settle_tab from the console
steps.expected: Screens hide /till, but the RPC still answers (blocks are screens only, by design)
steps.why: Owner must know blocks are not a security wall

steps.check: Deactivate a staff member while signed in on phone and operator
steps.expected: Sessions end; push token cleared; RPCs refuse

steps.check: Try to block a page or set a second job on an owner account
steps.expected: set_staff_access refuses for owners
steps.why: Owners must never be locked out

steps.check: As manager open /wages, /rewards, /analytics and /assistant by URL
steps.expected: Route guard sends them back; the RPCs refuse too

steps.check: As manager read an owner_only file on /files
steps.expected: Not listed

steps.check: As cashier open /desk, /stock, /admin, /safe
steps.expected: Refused by the guard
steps.why: Cashiers do not run the desk or the safe

steps.check: As cashier create a customer (desk-customer-create)
steps.expected: 403 FORBIDDEN

steps.check: As court_desk open /till and /kds
steps.expected: Refused

steps.check: As waiter open /till on the operator
steps.expected: Refused

steps.check: As head barista decide a chef idea
steps.expected: Refused (heads review their own team)

steps.check: As barista open the floor order screen
steps.expected: Guard sends them back (not in FLOOR_ROLES)

points.title: Role x system access matrix: Who can and cannot use it (2 of 2)

steps.check: As assistant barista propose a recipe change
steps.expected: Not offered (RECIPE_CHANGE_ROLES)

steps.check: As head chef open /stock on the operator
steps.expected: Refused (manager, owner); stock is on the phone

steps.check: As chef decide a deduction
steps.expected: Not offered and refused

steps.check: As driver see prices or other people's data
steps.expected: Nothing beyond the shopping list and own purchases (0157 least access)
steps.why: Store review account must be minimal

steps.check: As marketing open /analytics or /reports
steps.expected: Refused; Insights shows words, levels and rounded shares only

steps.check: As shop staff open /till or /stock
steps.expected: Refused

steps.check: As a coach, open another coach's statements
steps.expected: Refused

steps.check: As a guest sign in to the operator
steps.expected: No workspace; nothing opens

steps.check: As a guest open a staff route on the phone (e.g. /staff-shopping deep link)
steps.expected: RequireStaff sends them back

steps.check: Sign in as anon (not signed in) on the operator and list the rail
steps.expected: Reaches exactly: Nothing (station setup only)
steps.why: A wrong rail exposes or hides work

steps.check: Sign in as anon (not signed in) on the phone and list Today / tabs
steps.expected: Reaches exactly: Browse availability, sign in/up, legal links
steps.why: Phone access must match the role

steps.check: As anon call any app.* RPC not on the publicByDesign list
steps.expected: Denied
